google_reviews.author: Jeff & Lisa Livingston
google_reviews.text: Char is great to work with and takes her time with you during your time of need. Your family will be well taken care of! I also recommend the After Care Service they offer. I worked with Morgan  and she waled me through everything one needs to do to take care of things after my wife's passing relieving my stress alot! A Sacred Moment treats your family like it was their family!

google_reviews.author: Alyssa Aggarwal
google_reviews.text: The staff at A Sacred Moment were so incredibly helpful, gracious, and respectful as we navigated the sudden passing of my father-in-law. My husband's family is from India, and they wanted to incorporate a number of cultural and religious rituals into the cremation arrangements. We worked with Colbe and she was so patient as we explained what we needed. She made the whole event happen within 56 hours of his passing and accommodated several last minute changes along the way. We were so lucky to have received a recommendation for A Sacred Moment's services. No one could have done a better job for us, especially under the circumstances. We highly recommend A Sacred Moment, in particular if your family has unique needs or wishes that need to be included in funeral or cremation services.

google_reviews.author: Larry Glaefke
google_reviews.text: My wonderful wife of over 25 years recently passed away unexpectedly. One of our daughters found A Sacred Moment. From the very first conversation with them we felt comfortable with their help. This is the first time that I've ever had to do this and they did a wonderful job helping us thru this. They were very respectful and I thank them for all that they did and how it was handled. I would recommend them if you have the need.

google_reviews.author: Cindy Olson
google_reviews.text: We would like to thank the wonderful staff of A Sacred Moment for making a difficult time so much easier for our family,  My mother who is 90 years old  lost her spouse of 73 years and was devastated.  We as a family were overwhelmed and so completely taken care of by Nova and the rest of the staff. There wasn't a question that they couldn't answer and their help was beyond our expectations. From the time we walked into their office we felt their compassion and warmth as if we were their family. They helped us with every decision that was needed with great respect and dignity.  My Mom was so thankful to have someone so caring help with the difficulty of losing a loved one after being together 75 years.  We completed my Dad's memorial with a Military honors burial at Tahoma National Cemetery this week that was completely planned for us by Nova.  It was the most moving experience our family could have imagined,   We would recommend A Sacred Moment to everyone we know.  They are a wonderful company to work with.

google_reviews.author: Sam Behrens
google_reviews.text: The staff at A Sacred Moment were so helpful putting together a service for my father who passed abruptly. We were very overwhelmed when it happened but Colbe was incredibly understanding and helpful navigation our options for a service. Colbe was so patient and accommodating as we had to plan around our family members flying in for the funeral. The service was very beautiful and we are very grateful to the staff of A Sacred Moment.

google_reviews.author: Kamyar Khoshdel
google_reviews.text:
A First‑Class Experience from Start to Finish!

My family and I are deeply grateful for the exceptional care and professionalism we received from Acacia Memorial Park & Funeral Home. From the very first moment to the final farewell, the entire experience was truly first class. Every detail was handled with sincerity, respect, and a level of compassion that went far beyond our expectations.

They ensured that my mother was honored with the dignity she deserved, and their thoughtful guidance made an incredibly difficult time feel a little lighter. A special thank‑you to Benjamin, the manager, whose kindness and attentiveness stood out from the beginning. He was an absolute delight to work with—genuinely caring, patient, and deeply committed to making sure everything was perfect.

Thank you for giving my mother the beautiful ceremony she deserved and for providing my family with a memory we will cherish forever. Your dedication and humanity made all the difference.

Thank you,

google_reviews.author: Ana Santos
google_reviews.text:
Everything I was offered, flowers and casket were more affordable if I purchased them elsewhere. Good with details, however they line their pockets really well. ( which is the industry standard).
My funeral director was very good. He notified me when the wrong casket arrived.
I was charged a make up fee and placing Mum in the casket ( even though I brought a hairdresser and makeup artist with me.i had to do a lot ofthe logistics ( constant phone calls to the church)..
I would advise everyone plan their funerals ahead of time.

google_reviews.author: Joanna Schoettler (SRG)
google_reviews.text:
Acacia Memorial Park is a lovely place to visit your love ones after they pass and if this is for you, what a place to hang out when you are gone!  Beautiful Redwoods, Sequoia, Blue Spruces, unique conifers, fountains, and benches throughout the park to remember the good times.  We have one or two plots available under a Blue Spruce in the Birch Section, near a lovely fountain and a peek-a-boo view of Mount Rainier and the Olympics.  It is close enough to the road, but far enough for privacy.  It is up on the SW area of the grounds.

There are many friends and family at this beautiful place.  The staff has always been responsive and kind during the grieving period.

Very thankful to my parents who made arrangements and pre-paid most costs prior to passing.  It made it much easier on handling all the arrangements.  Also, the coordination with People's Memorial was a blessing as well.

google_reviews.author: Thanh Nguyen
google_reviews.text: Outstanding staff, service, and resources. Beautiful and clean campus and facility. Great warmth memories left behind for our last journey for our family member. I am grateful for the outstanding experience and help from Acadia and staff. Thanks Skylar and Jack for the hard work you do!

google_reviews.author: Debra Herrmann
google_reviews.text: Skyler attended to every detail, not only with my Dad's passing in February, but then again, for my Mom in July.  This was a huge sadness and heaviness for our family, losing both parents who had a stayed vibrant, and having just spent their 70th wedding anniversary together.  At every turn of the way, Skyler reached out to offer his help wherever he could in the planning of their memorials and of their wishes. John, Ben, Chi, the entire staff at Acacia are concerned and caring..I would Never hesitate to offer their compassionate services, and the ease with which we were able to order quality catering, the most beautiful and freshest of flowers, and the coordination of video presentations.  They worked warmly with our minister, and pretty much saw innately, every detail to attend to.  A flood of gratitude for Skyler, and everyone at Acacia, for their gracious souls!

google_reviews.author: Trina Marie
google_reviews.text:
My sweetie and I both lost a family member in the Spokane area in 2025. Advantage Funeral & Cremation Service is truly a wonderful group. We are out of state. These folks were there for us from start to finish. Took care of everything for us!! Walked us through the paper work in the middle of these ruff times. Kind, personable, paitent.
Local or out of state. Contact Advantage Funeral & Cremation Service.

google_reviews.author: Meagen Hoy
google_reviews.text: I was helping my roommate make pre-arrangements for his cremation and I reached out to Dignity Memorial.  Upon explaining our needs, our director Seamus made a recommendation for Advantage Funeral and Cremation.  We were looking for direct cremation with a couple of add ons. We got exactly what we wanted and the process was explained as we went along. Seamus is honest, kind, friendly, down to earth,  and provided us with a great planning experience. Highly recommend using Advantage Funeral and Cremation.

google_reviews.author: Gabrielle Humphrey
google_reviews.text: We worked closely with Crystal Weaver, and she was absolutely fantastic. My mother unfortuantely passed away right before the holidays, and everything happened to quickly, we were actually referred to Advantage by the hospital (Sacred Heart) Crystal was with us through every step of the process, and awnsered every question I had, even if it was dumb. She was so kind and compassionate, and wonderful to work with. I would reccomend Advantage to anyone. They made the process so unbelievably smooth, especially with what we as a family were goinf through, and they even given grief support for up to a year after your loved one passes, which is incredible imo.

google_reviews.author: D W
google_reviews.text: My family and I would like to thank Crystal W. for all of her help in planning my father’s cremation. She has been very helpful and compassionate throughout the entire process. We highly recommend Advantage Funeral and Cremation. Thank you.

google_reviews.author: Dawn Flees
google_reviews.text: Absolutely so caring and thoughtful,  helped me through the worst time in my life!! The staff are amazing, kind, caring and did not feel rushed to make decisions or pressured. Very compassionate

google_reviews.author: Hans Lain
google_reviews.text:
(please see image for my full personal words - Google review limits word count - AI summary)

I highly recommend this place and their services. They cared for my mom’s remains with compassion from start to finish. We chose a Witness Cremation, which at first felt uncomfortable, but being present proved meaningful and brought peace. We placed Mom’s treasured items with her, and Casey offered to play her Spotify playlist. Hearing Sinatra’s “My Way” was powerful. Casey guided us gently through every step. Caleb handled Mom’s transport with care, and Heather and Ashley were excellent with communication and coordination. All County treated our family with respect and helped us move through a sacred and difficult moment with trust and comfort.

google_reviews.author: Brenda Hugdahl
google_reviews.text: Very respectful,My Mom passed September 5th in hospice the gentleman that came to pick her up was so respectful and kind. I appreciate everyone that communicated and helped us through everything. I am so grateful for everyone I spoke to at all county. Thank you for everything.

google_reviews.author: Jason Young
google_reviews.text:
We recently had to use this crematory during the passing of our loved one, and while the process itself was handled, the human side of the experience left us deeply disappointed.

When meeting with Lexi in the office, the interaction felt very “all business” and sterile. There was no warmth, compassion, or sense of connection — just a detached, procedural tone that made an already painful situation feel even harder.

Similarly, a phone conversation with Nick felt transactional, like calling a service professional rather than someone entrusted with the final care of a family member.

In contrast, working with Heather and her partner at the crematory was the complete opposite. They were kind, compassionate, and genuinely connected to what we were going through. They treated us with empathy, even offering hugs, and made us feel cared for and supported. That compassion made all the difference, and it’s exactly what grieving families need.

Our hope in sharing this review is that the crematory reflects on these differences. Professionalism matters, but compassion and empathy matter just as much — if not more — during such an emotional and difficult time.

google_reviews.author: Matthew Christy
google_reviews.text: Nick and All County’s staff were incredible! Losing my husband unexpectedly, left me feeling very lost. Nick guided me through the whole process from start to finish.  It was so reassuring to know I could trust these people and that my husband was in good hands. It is obvious that the team at All County genuinely care about the people they serve! Thank you Nick, and everyone at All County!

google_reviews.author: Tamara Scherette
google_reviews.text:
Thank you so much, Nick for caring for our beloved Bubba. Ivan was comforted by your compassion, sympathy, and care. We so appreciated the special touches you provided. I'm grateful every day to see the beautiful urn. During a time of such grief, you were a brightness better than we had ever hoped for.
Sincerely,
The Scherette Family

google_reviews.author: Julie Purvis
google_reviews.text: Very professional. Quick to return calls and answer questions. They made a very hard thing to go through more bearable, and walked me through every step. Everyone one I spoke to was very kind and empathetic. They are fantastic.

google_reviews.author: Michael Grove
google_reviews.text: When we lost or son unexpectantly we needed a cremation service and had no idea of where to go.  We knew we wanted to be local and after some research we found Alpha Omega in Mount Vernon.  They were very helpful and respectful of our situation.  Everything was handled professionally and in accordance with our expectations - they made it as easy for us as was possible.  I would not hesitate to recommend them to others.

google_reviews.author: ED KEMPER
google_reviews.text: Their service was excellent but they were not clear about the overtime charges for pickup. If the pickup is done at home it takes 2 people so the charge is doubled.

google_reviews.author: Roxann Fisk
google_reviews.text: They were very respectful and kind towards my father. They took great care in their customer service when speaking to me and assisting with our families needs.

google_reviews.author: Heinz. Reinke
google_reviews.text: Very Customer care-focused and understanding of the situation.  They are definitely our go-to for repeat business.

google_reviews.author: Rikki Minder
google_reviews.text: They are unbelievably professional and kind. They have been nothing but helpful and accommodating. They walk you through every step, essential when you don't know where to even begin. If we ever need this service again, I would definitely call them. I have recommended them to others because they were just so wonderful and treated us so well. Just so kind. They have an office dog that makes everything better too 🩷🐾

google_reviews.author: Dior Ella
google_reviews.text:
Tari Dexter provided compassionate and dignified support during a time of loss. From the initial arrangements to the private viewing itself, Tari handled every detail with care and professionalism. Tari was attentive and understanding, guiding through the process with utmost grace and empathy. We are grateful for the support during this difficult time.
Tari exceeded all our expectations with her unparalleled attention to detail and personalized approach. Every aspect of the service was meticulously crafted to honor one's life in a truly unique and meaningful way. Every element was executed flawlessly. Tari demonstrated genuine compassion and went above and beyond to ensure that every guest felt supported and comforted.
Just read all the reviews, each one mentions her. It's truly remarkable how individuals independently express the same admiration for a top-notch service without any prior communication. This shared experience speaks volumes in regard to the exceptional service and its profound impact. It reflects a universal acknowledgment of excellence and underscores the profound way in which Tari touches the lives of everyone she encounters, creating a collective narrative of appreciation and respect.
Thank you, Tari!

google_reviews.author: N W
google_reviews.text:
I unexpectedly recently lost my fiance and was referred to ACCA. They where so amazingly kind, understanding, and helpful during this process which was difficult for me emotionally. Great customer service, so caring and showed such compassion and empathy. The price was affordable compared to many other places,
and they where upfront with everything so no surprises which I greatly appreciated during this time. Amy was so kind to meet me as I live further away and she was just so amazing in person. Thank you for what you do and the service you provide.

google_reviews.author: kristin walton
google_reviews.text: My mom passed away recently and we were referred to American cremation from our Hospice team. They were very helpful through the whole process, extremely kind and professional. I would definitely recommend them to friends and family

google_reviews.author: Thomas Johnston
google_reviews.text:
The staff at American Cremation and Casket Alliance were outstanding!  They were patient and compassionate when I needed them the most.  Their prices were very reasonable and transparent.  Amy even met me halfway to deliver my wife's ashes to me.
I would recommend them highly to anyone needing funeral or cremation services.
Thank You!!!

google_reviews.author: Virginia Abeyta
google_reviews.text: The funeral director was very nice and helpful no extra charges. I would use them again

google_reviews.author: Debbie Fought
google_reviews.text: They told me I had to pay an extra $200.00 for afterhours service for picking up my Mom.  They said their hours were 8 to 5 They were called at 4:00 p.m. and it took them 2 and a half hours to get Mom.  I told them I would not pay that, it was not my fault it took them 2 and half hours to come.  Mom and Dad had bought the cremation service from them many years ago.  They said they couldn't find the paperwork so I would have to pay again.  Then when I told them I had the original copy they said Oh yes here it is we have it.  Don't use them.

google_reviews.author: les
google_reviews.text:
We arranged for the cremation and paid in full. Now the ashes are being held for ransom. They called 8 days after payment asking for SS number that they could not find on their paperwork. Said that if we wanted cremation done sooner we would have to pay$450 extra. We had to return home and was told that the shipment would normally cost extra, but the fee would be waived. Now they have called saying that the shipment would not be waived and that we would not get the remains sent with out paying another$150-.
This feels like extortion and comes at a terrible time. Our emotionally distraught disabled daughter is experiencing extreme distress and panic.
What kind of insensitive monsters are operating this funeral business.

google_reviews.author: Patty Gratz
google_reviews.text: The day my mom passed we call the card in her purse with the phone number for American Memorial Funeral Directors. We spoke with James Colt from the Tacoma office.  We called first to let them know and they said they would send a disposal vehicle to pick our mom up.  Really a "disposal vehicle". We asked questions about where they were going to take her and all they said was Kent. Kent is a large city and they could not give me a specific location.  After hanging up my sister thought about it and decided were not going to place our loved one in the care of these flaky people.  I called back and said I was cancelling the service - do not come to pick up our mom.  James said I had to use them or I would going against the law.  We ended up getting in a huge fight and I said "my mom just passed away, we do not need this" and he answered back "yes I know your mom is dead" then hung up on me.  He sent someone anyway and we told that person we had made other arrangements and did not need their services. She sat in the drive way and we got another call from James who said "he had someone already called who was sitting in the driveway and we would have to pay for that person".  Long story we did not use American Memorial Funeral Directors and when we requested a refund from them for my moms insurance she had pre-paid they refused and said we used it up with the lady sitting in the driveway. I requested a copy of ours mom contract with him on 3 occasions and have yet to receive a copy.  i have reported this company to the DOL Cemetery Board. They should not be allowed to stay in business.  We ended up using the services of a wonderful company of our choice and had the most amazing experience we could have hoped for. I am still trying to get a copy of my moms contract but with not luck. DO NOT USE AMERICAN MEMORIAL FUNERAL DIRECTORS!

google_reviews.author: David Kosar
google_reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in the initial meeting with Barbara at the Everett location. Never once we were offered condolences. She was extremely disorganized and made the meeting drag out to well over 2 1/2 hours. She could not remember the name of my deceased father or me as we went through the paperwork. Sadly, she made this more about her than about honoring my dad. She did provide some good tips for airfare and overall they delivered my dad on time for his funeral with the expedited service. However, Barbara made this an extremely stressful vs. putting us at east. I am sorry to say this, but I would never use the Everett location again.

google_reviews.author: Myra Byrnes
google_reviews.text: They provided great service for both my Brother and Mother. I told Barbara we have to stop meeting this way😊 I like how they explained the process step by step. We laughed and we cried but she has a way of allowing you to mourn and grieve. Tootsie Rolls and Kleenex  Tissue go hand in hand. Thank You 💜

google_reviews.author: Doug Vickroy
google_reviews.text:
The people of American Memorial have been the very best in reaching out during this challenging time in life
. My sister died from Alcoholism, and allowing her 33,000 dollars was tragic by the executor of Grace Vickroys estate. Sue Haage is responsible.
God bless the good people, and Barbara of this American Mermorial in Everett
Douglas Vickroy

And after a follow up phone call today, I was asked to resubmit because they cannot find the originally mailed to and signed by them.  And finally, I was told the only person able to issue the check due, is out of the office for 10 days and no one else has the ability to handle this?  Really?  I would strongly consider other options and can only hope that someone else's experience would be much better than mine has.

google_reviews.author: Tom & Georgia Shriver
google_reviews.text: We have dealt with American Memorial on 4 occasions and we highly recommend them to those people we know.  They have been GREAT to deal with. They treat both the deceased and family members with caring and respect.

google_reviews.text: Due to unfortunate circumstances, I had to have my loved one creamated. These people cared more about the money than my loved one. the Secretary was so nice though.

google_reviews.author: Cynthia Austin
google_reviews.text:
I cannot begin to express how impressed I am with The Barton Family Funeral Service.  My mother passed away and I needed to have her shipped from WA to SLC where she was to be buried. From the moment Andrew came to get my mom I knew we were in kind and competent hands.  I have worked with other funeral homes and have felt stressed by the decisions and costs.  The Barton family made it abundantly clear that they were just there to help me do whatever our family wanted.  Their concern was authentic. Angela helped us make all the arrangements and was so personable and caring.  In the end, the cost was significantly lower than the funeral home in SLC who did far less.

I would give them 10 stars (if possible)  and my highest recommendation.  They made a difficult situation as positive as possible.

google_reviews.author: Judy Patneaude
google_reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience working with Brandie at Barton Family Funeral Home. Everyone on their staff were very clear in their communications, prompt in answering questions, friendly and caring. I can't recommend them enough.

google_reviews.author: J W
google_reviews.text: Brandie and Angela were extremely helpful in several situations. I truly appreciated their level of communication and I thought the pricing was extremely reasonable. Thank you Barton Family  🙏🏻

google_reviews.author: Saurabh Agrawal
google_reviews.text: Pat Barton and Steven Barton are the kindest and most helpful people I have met. When we needed  them, they supported us in a timely manner. Pat picked up our phone calls on weekend, arranged for a cremation first thing Monday, cleared all the paperwork in a timely manner, as promised. She provided all relevant documentation including ordering the death certificate. Steve Barton did a wonderful job in arranging the witnesses cremation, provided us extra 30 minutes before and did not rush us towards the end. There were no hidden charges in the bill. Thank you Pat and Steven. Our family is forever grateful for your efforts.

google_reviews.author: M R
google_reviews.text: I asked for 3 separate bags for my mother's cremated body. I offered to pay extra if necessary. I explained with strong emphasis on the reason why. One was mailed to my brother, and 2 were supposed to be sent to me. I received only one. I now have to find another container and painstakingly separate her ashes before bringing them to her place of birth at a foreign country to her family to have their own shared farewell experience. I have gone through enough, and simply separating her ashes in 3 were all I asked. I feel this was completely ignored as I'm deeply hurt over the loss of my mother and now have to shuffle her ashes feels disrespectful as this could have been avoided. Angela, however, was wonderful in making the process seamless even when I came back to change my order to add more certificates.

google_reviews.author: Dan Warren
google_reviews.text:
Extremely professional, yet sympathetic and friendly staff.  They take care of so many things, so you don’t have to.  Extremely knowledgeable and helpful in navigating the entire process.  Our family has used Bauer twice and will do so again when needed without hesitation.

When my dad was in hospice, they took the time to listen to what we wanted and offer options for that and didn't try to sell us what we didn't want.  It was greatly appreciated.

google_reviews.author: Melanie Garcia
google_reviews.text: Bauer did a wonderful job helping us with the unfortunate process of dealing with my moms death. They answered all our questions. They were compassionate and caring. I would highly recommend them as a professional and caring company.

google_reviews.author: Karen Black
google_reviews.text: I recently had the experience of working with Bauer Funeral Home, and I can't speak highly enough of the care and compassion they provided during such a difficult time. The staff was incredibly understanding, offering support every step of the way, while maintaining professionalism and respect. The facilities were peaceful, and everything was handled with the utmost dignity. They made the process as smooth as possible, allowing our family to focus on what truly mattered. Highly recommended for anyone in need of thoughtful and considerate services.

google_reviews.author: Diana Munko
google_reviews.text: The level of kindness, respect, and helpfullness the employees at Bauer Funeral Chapel displayed is unsurpassed. They made the entire process for me and my family seamless and comforting. I most highly recommend them for preplanning as well as at time of loss.

google_reviews.author: A B
google_reviews.text: My mom had prearranged her funeral wishes prior to her death.  Bauer Funeral Chapel was very professional and easy to work with.  We appreciate their care and compassion of our mom.

google_reviews.author: Shayna Besch
google_reviews.text:
Let me preface this with the fact that I never leave negative reviews. If I could give ZERO STARS to this establishment I would.
My uncle passed away today and is still laying in the spot he passed away in as we speak.
My mom contacted this funeral home 7 hours ago for transportation of our loved one's body. Beck's has given us multiple excuses, told us multiple different timeframes, blamed my mom (my uncle's caretaker) for not informing them to head that way, told us they would be here within 10 minutes (never came), and now they will not answer any of the numbers they have given to us and one of their phones for a direct contact has even been turned off. We are now trying to find a different funeral home for pick up because Beck's isn't responding and hasn't come. What is going on???!? This is actually cruel, unacceptable, and extremely uncaring given that my uncle has been dead 12 hours now and my mom is grieving and exhausted and has been waiting all day for his body to be recieved, and all we have gotten is lies and inconsideration for our loved one from this home. It is a completely clear sunny day so no inclement weather to keep them from coming in a timely manner.
If this is how they treat their customers for pick up, I don't want to think about how they may treat loved ones remains behind closed doors. Completely unacceptable and I am disgusted. I would not, and will not ever recommend this funeral home.

Update: a lady named Colleen just called my mom back and left a message. She said they were working on a transportation team because they had others "stacked in front of you" AND LAUGHED. She said their estimated time of arrival would now be 3 hours from now in between 10 - 10:30 pm. That is 10 hours from when we called and they have lied multiple times about ETA'S and why they haven't shown up or picked up. Their treatment of our family has been absolutely unacceptable and atrocious.

Update #2: we called a different funeral home who arrived in an hour. Communicated with us the entire time. Brought us flowers and were kind and empathetic that we just had lost a loved one. They treated our loved one's body with care and respect. The exact opposite of Beck's, and how a funeral home should handle such situations. I still cannot believe how they treated my family in our moment of grief and need. What a disrespectful company.

google_reviews.author: Cheri Prudnick
google_reviews.text:
Our son recently passed away and we were honored to have worked with Beck's Funeral and Tribute Center. We worked specifically with Samantha Webb. She was exceptional. She took such great care of our son and our entire family. Anytime we had questions, she answered immediately even if we repeated ourselves. She helped with everything, right down to being at the service and pitching in where needed.
I highly recommend Beck's, they are all very nice and good at what they do. If you have a chance to work with Samantha, you will be very fortunate.

google_reviews.author: Brian prouty
google_reviews.text:
I am terribly disappointed in Beck's lack of professionalism, courtesy, communication, and empathy during a family's time of need. We had a resident pass at our senior living community and the family had Beck's listed as the provider of choice.

After the initial intake with their call center, Beck's did not reach out to our community indicating that dispatch scheduled a driver nor did we receive a follow up call regarding their ETA as promised. 3 hours later, after still no word from Beck's, the family was told by Beck's staff they "may get an update in the next few hours". After 5 hours, we tried again attempted to receive an update with no luck. After 6 hours, I placed another call to Beck's asking for an update and still no apology, no update, and no one had a clue what was happening. I was promised a call from the Director "immediately". After 7 hours, the family terminated the service and, thankfully, another funeral home service stepped in afterhours to save the day.

In following up the next day, I spoke with Amanda (a Director at Becks); at no point did she offer an apology or take accountability for the actions of her team. She simply thanked me for the call and seemed to have zero interest or concern about what this family was going through, or their shock about this lack of service, or the cavalier attitude of the staff when facing such a perilous situation.

I can't, in good faith, recommend this service following this experience.

google_reviews.author: Linh N
google_reviews.text: My dad recently past away.  Beck's was so kind and patient with us.  They answered and explained every details to us.  Everyone from sales to transport took their time with us and were very respectful.  Pricing wise were reasonable and affordable.   We highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: John Winskie
google_reviews.text: When my wife passed away, I immediately thought of Beck's to help with her cremation and Celebration of Life, since I live nearby and had walked my dogs by there hundreds of times in the past. I was immediately impressed with how empathetic and efficient they were in carrying out my every wish, and how personable and sympathetic everyone on the staff were. The Celebration of Life ended up being one of the best I had ever attended in my life, in no small measure due to their professionalism. They were set up incredibly well, and made it a memorable experience for everyone. My personal thanks to Joshua, Amber, Krista, Samantha, and Jack, and to others who's names I missed. If I could have given them 6 stars, I would have! I recommend them wholeheartedly!

google_reviews.author: Finn Boss
google_reviews.text: Just a building

google_reviews.author: Tylor Dove
google_reviews.text: I have had such an amazing experience since making Capitol Hill Dental Group my dentist office. The entire team makes you feel very comfortable, and ensures you are making the most informed dental decisions! I especially want to shout out Dr. Koh, Ji, and Kayla for always taking such good care of me when I come in!

google_reviews.author: Beth Johnson
google_reviews.text: Dr. Koh is such a compassionate person and Dentist. Her bedside manner is exemplary. She says please and thank you not just to her patience, but to her fellow employees that’s everything that’s comfort. Cole is as awesome. He was very gentle. He was very kind. He was very considerate.💜

google_reviews.author: Kasie Schroeder
google_reviews.text:
Love the team here! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. I never feel shamed for my lack of flossing but they do a great job of giving me all the info I need to be more successful! This place is great if you don’t have dental insurance because they try to help with as many discounts as they can to make the services more affordable (as well as payment plans)
Shoutout to Dr. Pruthi, Kayla and Tylor for helping me today! Yall were great as always :)

google_reviews.author: R Carr
google_reviews.text: Such a good place! Andzelikka took care of me today and it was one of the best appointments I’ve had. She was so kind and Informative it just made the time fly by. I appreciated the information she shared as well as being able to answer questions I had with further advice. The front staff was also very nice making my experience really peaceful and easy!

google_reviews.author: Hannah Jarden
google_reviews.text: I’ve tried a couple different locations within this network of dental offices and the Capitol Hill location is by far the best. Everyone is very kind and patient, Justin is such a friendly face at the desk and also very helpful with any questions you have with billing, payment plans, or getting your next few appointments scheduled. And Dr. Pruthi and Kayla the hygienist have completely turned my dental hygiene around for the better. I’ve always had problem teeth, but they took the time to answer all my questions, give recommendations for different routines to try, and educated me as to what’s going on in my mouth and why. I will literally travel out of my way to continue going to this office, should I ever move. They’ve made me no longer nervous or scared to go to the dentist!!! Can’t recommend them enough.

google_reviews.author: Ellen Ballardo
google_reviews.text: Very good experience here. They took good care of my grandma and my mom. Thank you.

google_reviews.author: zxdfty77
google_reviews.text:
Staff was very compassionate and sensitive towards us.
Paperwork and formalities were handled very efficiently. Very kind.
...I hope we'll never need to go back there again! 😉

google_reviews.author: Billie & Jonathan Collins
google_reviews.text: I have used Bonney Watson for 3 pre need appointment for pre arrangements & hands down the best care & more responsive, respectful & caring staff.

google_reviews.author: Darray Murphy
google_reviews.text: I had a terrible experience with this funeral home. They gave my family a difficult time in burying my grandmother. I would not recommend to others.

google_reviews.author: Charles Davis
google_reviews.text: Very professional. Chapel was clean and very peaceful. Good for intimate services.

google_reviews.author: Sang Lee
google_reviews.text:
We recently held the funeral service for my wife and entrusted Bonney Watson Funeral Home with the arrangements. From the beginning, they treated her with dignity and care.
Funeral Director Harley guided us with warmth and compassion, helping our family through every step of the process. She kept in close contact, informed us of all the details, and comforted us in our grief. The chapel service and cremation were handled seamlessly, and Harley even coordinated the interment at Tahoma National Cemetery for us.
Mika also prepared the slideshow, printed programs, and service guides with great care, allowing us to focus on our family and our memories.
On behalf of my family, I sincerely thank Bonney Watson Funeral Service, Harley, and Mika for their professionalism, kindness, and support. We are truly grateful and highly recommend their services.

google_reviews.author: Strictly FB
google_reviews.text:
Our family has trusted Bonney Watson for years, but this experience was deeply disappointing. What we were told in meetings didn’t match what actually happened, and communication was poor. We weren’t updated about major delays until we followed up ourselves.

I understand staffing challenges, but grieving families deserve honesty and compassion. Sadly, this experience has broken our trust in a company we once highly respected. I truly hope no other family has to go through what we did. I do not recommend working directly with Bonney Watson, especially with  Bri Hendricks when ordering your loved one’s stone, work directly with the stone company. Even reporting the experience to their president Laura Frampton in person did not make a difference. At the end of the day, there’s no integrity and they don’t care if you had a bad experience, as long as they get their money.

google_reviews.author: Alameda Taamu
google_reviews.text: A whole bunch of broken promises. Used our vulnerability to take our money. Spent over 18k for the stone and was promised a time that it would be ready. In our Samoan culture, we celebrate the 1 year milestone of our loved one’s death. They said it would be ready a certain time. But here we are with no stone and no response on when it’ll be ready. Bonny Watson you make more than enough money from our Samoan families to treat us like this. 30+ years my family has been doing business with yall. I hope my Samoan folks after me don’t make the same Mistake. The ladies name was Brianna H. Who no longer works there now lol and Laura the president just beats around the bush and points fingers at lower level employees.

google_reviews.author: Chelle Myers
google_reviews.text: Carlos Zamora is an excellent and personable employee of Bonney Watson.  Carlos assisted us in the pre-planning stage to the final headstone and everything in between!  He is focused and his attention to details was outstanding!  His expertise made a very difficult time in our life very manageable!  I can’t imagine going through it all without Carlos!

google_reviews.author: Ice Qu
google_reviews.text:
So many ways of honoring and remembering our loved ones! This well run, heartfelt operation is truly a fitting place for the eternal rest. In particular is how lovely the grounds are with all the different enclaves where the sacred atmosphere really comes through. Quite a surprise when you think of it, because the airport is right near it.
The focus is on respect and remembering, with gorgeous greenery and easy to navigate pathways. However I must mention my personal favorite area where the service personnel are honored with flags and monument plus the amazing metal plaques displaying copies of wartime documents that herald change, hope, and peace.
What a gift to everyone, living in this world or the next!

google_reviews.author: Jen Temple
google_reviews.text:
Brookside funeral homes has to be one of the most amazing businesses I have dealt with!  In a time of tragedy, they have made an extremely difficult process easier to bare. They went over and above to accommodate crazy schedules and treated us with such a compassion, kindness, and genuine love they truly do feel like a family.  I highly recommend them for any funeral services!

Thank you for everything🩷

Jen Temple

google_reviews.author: erikajoy clayton
google_reviews.text:
During the most heartbreaking time of our lives—the passing of our couple-day-old son—Jamin, Mahala, and the entire Brookside team showed us extraordinary compassion, patience, and care. Their kindness and sensitivity during such an unimaginable loss meant more to our family than words can express.

They made every detail incredibly sentimental and meaningful, honoring our son with such thoughtfulness and love. Nothing felt rushed or impersonal. Instead, we felt supported, seen, and cared for in a way that brought comfort during an otherwise unbearable time.

Because of the care they showed our son and our family, Brookside will always hold a special place in our hearts. They are no longer just a service provider to us—they are forever family. We will always be grateful for the grace, dignity, and compassion they showed us during the most painful season of our lives.

google_reviews.author: Cherri Kroner
google_reviews.text: On January 2, 2025, our family experienced the worst loss we could go through. We lost our 16 year old son to suicide. It’s been an experience I wouldn’t wish on anyone. And yet, through this tremendous loss, we also experienced love, respect and the most sincerest kindness any humans could extend. The Mohler family and Brookside as a whole, loved us and loved us well. They took care of issues that were outside of a funeral home’s normal range of responsibilities. They loved our son in life, they loved him in death, and in the midst of our grief, they showed us a kindness and compassion that can never be fully explained but will forever be cherished. I’m so thankful for their hearts. They are the most skilled and loving people in their industry. ❤️

google_reviews.author: Bill Kroner
google_reviews.text: We chose brookside because of their reputation as a family business. Throughout the process they were able to provide options,  solve problems and adapt when needed.  Everything was respectful and above board. They were kind, respectful, and highly skilled. My family and I are forever grateful for their help during the hardest season of our lives.

google_reviews.author: Amanda Clemmons
google_reviews.text: My family is so appreciative of the compassionate care that we received recently at Brookside when we lost my father. Donna was wonderful to work with. Everything was handled with the utmost professionalism. My father died at home and the gentlemen who picked him up were discreet and compassionate and so professional. They made a sad day just a little bit better. We're very grateful.

google_reviews.author: Heather Pinkerton
google_reviews.text:
From start to finish, Rebecca and Julie provided exceptional customer service and compassion to our family.  My mother-in-law had prepaid for her service and given me the business card for Brown years ago.  When she passed, I just gave Brown a call and was able to meet with Rebecca within hours.  It was such a relief to have the assistance that Brown provided.  I cannot recommend Brown Mortuary and specifically Rebecca and Julie enough.  They went out of their way to make things as organized, timely and painless as possible.

Thank you!!!

google_reviews.author: Nichole Dahlin (VikingsGurl19)
google_reviews.text:
My experience with Brown's Mortuary was amazing, I don't know what I would have done without their services.
From the moment I walked in the door Malynda the funeral director was compassionate and so understanding to the sudden and unexpected loss of my husband. She walked me thru each step and made what is a very painful process so much easier to work thru so that it created space for me to grieve in my loss.
I would also like to add that the Dignity food catering services that Brown's offered did an incredible job. The food was well presented and the staff friendly and very professional.

Thank you again for helping me and my family create a wonderful celebration for our dearly departed loved one, we are forever grateful.

google_reviews.author: Nancy Nelson
google_reviews.text:
Thank you so much for making the experience of handling my aunt’s death with care and professionalism.  The workers at her adult family home raved about how caring and professional your people were.  They said your mortuary service was a class act compared to many others they deal with.
Gary was extremely kind and helpful with the details of my aunt’s final wishes.  I am so very thankful that my aunt had prearranged her service with Brown Mortuary.  The whole experience was a class act.

google_reviews.author: Sherry Ticknor
google_reviews.text: During a very stressful time in our life with the liss of my dad Malynda Wilson and Julie have been mist helpful in taking care of arrangements for him from start to finish.

google_reviews.author: Jacqueline Schlagel
google_reviews.text: Rebecca was kind and answered all my questions and concerns.  No one was pushing any services or products I did not want or need.  Everyone was helpful and took care of all that I needed done.  Thank you.

google_reviews.author: Polyester Avalanche
google_reviews.text:
I stopped by the Brown Mortuary booth at the Logger's Jubilee festival.  The two young ladies that I visited with were very friendly and surprisingly knowledgeable about estate planning.  We discussed how financial planning (an area of my expertise) frequently overlooks expenses for funerals and other after-death expenses.  No one within a family likes to think or talk about death, but it's considerably easier prior to it's occurrence, rather than after.

We briefly discussed the costs associated with different services (burial, cremation, additional fees, prepayment of funeral, etc.).  I plan to follow up with them to make sure that I have a solid plan in place for both my mother and myself.  They were very helpful!

google_reviews.author: Billy Jenkins
google_reviews.text:
In my time of need i found you to be professional and compassionate, i feel you went above board to satisfy my every need.
I highly recommend your services to anyone in such a delicate situation.

Bill Jenkins

google_reviews.author: Heidi P
google_reviews.text: Going with the local, small town, familiar mortuary was unquestionably the best decision we made. Mindy Rocha-Barella, the funeral director at Brown Mortuary, was extraordinary.

google_reviews.author: Clint Utter
google_reviews.text:
The ladies are really in tune with what your feeling.
I felt calm for the first time in weeks..plus the planning was fast and easy to understand.

google_reviews.author: Bob Hunt
google_reviews.text: Small, well run operation. They know their business and handle the details and take care of the client.

google_reviews.author: A Shanafelt
google_reviews.text: My friend lost her partner suddenly and I had called a different place first. They ended up majorly dropping the ball. I called Browns and they got to my friends loved one very timely. She ran into some issues with the doctor signing the death certificate but Browns made it happen for her. They even went above and beyond by bringing his remains to her house so she wouldn't have to make the drive. They are amazing!

google_reviews.author: Olive
google_reviews.text: I'm still trying to navigate the waves of grief after losing my mom, but working with Nick Brown was a beacon of hope and comfort. His kindness, understanding, and gentle guidance helped me and my family feel seen and supported in ways we never thought possible. Nick Brown's compassion and care for my mom were truly remarkable, and I'm so grateful for the extra time he spent helping us. This review is more than just words – it's a heartfelt thank you for being a steady presence during life's most challenging moments. If you're looking for someone to hold space for you with love and empathy, Brown's Funeral and crematory is the one.

google_reviews.author: James Holcomb
google_reviews.text: Nathan was great. Got Grandma all taken care of and was friendly and nice to chat with. Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Shaun D
google_reviews.text: Brown's is one of the most caring funeral homes in the market. When my brother unfortunately passed away, Nick was there immediately, in the middle of the night, to take care of my family and me. I could not ask for better care or a simpler process. Nick took care of everything, leaving us with the space and time to grieve. With so many funeral homes being bought out by huge corporations, having a locally owned funeral home, from a local family, just felt right, and we were treated as if he’d known my family and me for years! I am eternally grateful for the work Nick did with my family, and how stress-free he made the whole process. It was one of the hardest times of our life, and I can’t imagine how much harder it would have been without Nick and his team there to take care of us.

google_reviews.author: Craig Jones
google_reviews.text: I recently lost my mother and had been recommended to Brown's for their services.  They handled all the transport needs as she was not local and maintained excellent communication through the process.  This is a phenomenal company, and I highly recommend them for helping to complete the final wishes for your loved one.

google_reviews.author: Mike Wazowski
google_reviews.text: Love the place. Throws really fun events.

google_reviews.author: Tarryn Anderson
google_reviews.text: These times are never easy, but they are so compassionate, and helpful. They truly want to help you get through the hardest decisions, and they are so easy to work with.

google_reviews.author: Lavonne Hall
google_reviews.text: I love the staff at Brunings- so kind and caring!  They are all helpful personally and professionally. ❤️

google_reviews.author: Johnny Fultz
google_reviews.text: I will say with how hard times our losing a loved one. This place has gone above and beyond. We have been working with Bailey and I can say she has been the brightest light in this dark time. From my family I want to say thank you so much and we truly appreciate everything.

google_reviews.author: Mona Kunselman
google_reviews.text:
I would like to give Butterworth Funeral Home my highest recommendation!
At a time of critical need, I felt comforted and outstandingly served by their team. I'm especially grateful for the funeral director Ms. Nikala Johnson for going above and beyond in attending to every detail and accommodating my special requests -- she illustrated the highest level of professionalism, knowledge and care. Thank you and best wishes.

google_reviews.author: Lisa Pevey
google_reviews.text:
We were so impressed with the professionalism and care they took with helping me and my family. Nikala and her team made every detail so nice and were at all of the services to provide support.
I would recommend them to anyone who is having to plan a funeral.

google_reviews.author: Pamela Matherly
google_reviews.text: Very comforting to us. We were in a place of what do we do, and at the same time we knew what needed to be done.  They were great in helping without being pushy. Thank you

google_reviews.author: Molly Christensen
google_reviews.text: Highly recommend the team at Butterworth Funeral Home. They were supportive, caring and helpful in taking care of all the steps needed with the death of our aunt.

google_reviews.author: Paula Yost
google_reviews.text: Dignity was responsive, understanding, compassionate and communicative.  Staff explained the process clearly and educated me in an area I have no knowledge about.  Their care allowed us to focus on what really matters, which was such a precious gift.

google_reviews.author: Susan Beecher
google_reviews.text: When my husband passed away, the hospice included Cady Cremation on the list of funeral homes that provided good service. I was not disappointed. The people at Cady were compassionate and focused on what I wanted and needed. They went out of their way to be helpful. I used their facility for the memorial gathering, and when one of my guests developed a medical emergency, they went above and beyond to help us handle it. The prices were reasonable, too. I highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: Stacie Cannard
google_reviews.text: We had a family member die in Washington state. He has no family there. He died unexpectedly and very young (38). Thankfully the hospital social worker provided me with several low cost cremation services. He died at such a young age. There was not a life insurance policy. We explained that we needed a low cost cremation and we were not turned away. Because of financial instability we were unable to fly to Seattle we had to do everything over the phone and through email. Holly was amazing. She went out of her way to make sure Cory was handled with care and dignity. She sent his ashes to several family members who live far apart per our request. She also sent a lock of his hair and his finger prints. The cost was so much less than other places but he was treated like royalty. We were treated the same way. google_reviews.author: Jacqueline Sandberg

google_reviews.author: Hannah S.
google_reviews.text:
I chose this company for a direct cremation for my mother. I was very appreciative of the straightforward pricing and friendly staff. They have worked quickly and been available to handle questions or concerns. Unfortunately, my experience hasn't been without problems. They got her birth date wrong on one of the forms (I caught the error, and to their credit, they revised it within an hour or so) but my biggest issue by far has been them contacting my grieving father when asked, respectfully, not to. I am the one who made arrangements with them, paid, filled out the forms and provided all the information for the death certificate, but each time I call they take down my info as if they have no record of me in their system. My parents celebrated their 40th anniversary days before my mom passed, and he is not in a good place. Every time they call he has a break down, and before this last call he was actually making progress. One of the last times I called they even asked, "Should we just talk to you only?" And I said yes, and they made it sound like that wish would be honored, unfortunately it was not. Overall I would recommend this place (just not to a grieving widow/
widower whose children will be handling arrangements) but I would do so with a word of warning. I do not think it's out of callousness or apathy, most likely it is a disconnect somewhere in their system or process, but I feel it's worth noting regardless.
