I cannot express enough gratitude for the exceptional care and compassion shown by Curnow Funeral Home during one of the most difficult times in my life. From the moment I first contacted them about my mother’s cremation, every step of the process was handled with the utmost respect, sensitivity, and professionalism.

They walked me through everything with incredible patience and clarity, ensuring that I never felt overwhelmed or alone. Every detail — from the initial arrangements to the final pickup of my Mothers remains was handled with such thoughtfulness and dignity. It was clear that this wasn’t just a job to them; they genuinely cared about honoring my mother and supporting me through my grief.

Their attention to detail and the calm, compassionate presence of the staff made all the difference. They created a space that allowed me mourn, reflect, and celebrate my mother’s life with peace of mind, knowing everything was taken care of with care and grace.

I am deeply thankful to Curnow for helping me navigate this difficult time and for treating my mother with such reverence. Their support was a true gift, and I will never forget it.

google_reviews.author: Holly D
google_reviews.text: We were very impressed with the care,  compassion and attention to detail we received from Curnow. The team we worked with was so approachable, patient with my many questions and handled the transporting of my mother seamlessly out of state. The staff made this difficult time so much more bearable.

google_reviews.author: Linda Johnson
google_reviews.text: Everyone at Curnow made us feel like we mattered. They were thoughtful and kind. The pickup of my husband was kind of a long wait. That was hard. But they were priced reasonably and made it an easy process. Their free grief counseling is the best!!

google_reviews.author: Rich Rucker
google_reviews.text: When I called Curnow Funeral Home, I requested a simple cremation with no urn. (My wife wanted to be scattered near a lake that she loved.) I felt support from the representative at Curnow. She was calm, asked a few questions to make sure she understood what I wanted. She did not suggest or recommend any additional services or products. I felt calm and reassured in dealing with her. Similarly, the delivery of the ashes to me was a calm, low-key meeting. The follow-up service that Curnow provided to me was a surprise. I received a series of emails suggesting things that needed to be done in the next month or so. That outreach was very helpful (comforting) to me. I am very pleased with my dealing with the Curnow Funeral Home.

google_reviews.author: Jane Hansen
google_reviews.text: Initially, I thought this was a wonderful facility to take care of my dad And help us handle the process of all the things that are involved when a loved one dies. But a couple weird things happened, including taking an excessive amount of time to get us a death certificate. And there was no phone calls that ever got returned so the day before his burial, we had to go in person to make sure that they were going show up at the graveside. I think part of the issue was that we were dealing with an intern who maybe did not have the supervision she should’ve had. It also took them an excessively long time to post the obituary on their website. I think when you’re going through a hard time and there’s not professionalism and there’s poor communication it causes high anxiety.

google_reviews.author: Jo-el Odell
google_reviews.text: Curnow came highly recommended when my Mom passed recently. I can understand why. They were so kind and compassionate and helped us through every step in the process. It was a very overwhelming time, and they made it a little easier knowing my moms remains were well cared for.

google_reviews.author: Daniela Ramos-Juarez
google_reviews.text: Never have i met this amazing staff but they did this for my boy and they won a space in my heart forever❤️ today is 10 years and saw it

google_reviews.author: Shirley Ellsworth
google_reviews.text: Danekas has long been a very professional service to the community.   Kindness and respect as well.

google_reviews.author: Cj Robison
google_reviews.text: My dad recently passed away and we had the service today. Wanted to say that Bill was absolutely amazing with helping my family through this time. Even though the covid 19 issue is still going on he made sure everything went through smoothly and flawless as possible. I do want to say thank you and recommend (not encouraging funeral services lol) that through funeral services that are needed, they are too notch and will go above and beyond to help in any way possible. Couldn't have asked for better service.

google_reviews.author: Sarah Ohair
google_reviews.text: Danekas did a wonderful job when my parents passed. They were kind, compassionate, and professional

google_reviews.author: Shelly S
google_reviews.text: Definitely needs improvement with customer and to stop the hard selling. Terrible to have someone tell you that you need 1000's of dollars for a cement liner so your loved one won't get crushed. Poor taste!!! There is definitely a kinder way to say that. Also, had to pay for obituary in advance and 3 wks later it is still not in the paper. Only place to go to in Colville unfortunately.

google_reviews.author: Hillary T
google_reviews.text: Katie was absolutely wonderful to work with and Allan did a great job of helping us to honor our Dad in his time of passing. Compassionate and kind, listened to what we wanted, and helped us to coordinate a beautiful memorial. A very professional and caring experience.

google_reviews.author: Sue Nichols
google_reviews.text: Jesse Bowman was so kind and patient; he followed a sheet with the pricing and quoted me the price. I did make one change, and he went back to the work sheet and included what I had asked for, in the final price. Jessie, and Allen Thompson, were so professional, they went out of their way to accommodate me at a very difficult time.

google_reviews.author: Jennia Atreyu
google_reviews.text: This dude Is a scam artist and a joke. He changed the price for my moms cremation not once but 3 times. Than my sister calls him and he lied saying it was still the original price and then blocks my calls and messages never trust people like this again.

google_reviews.author: Aaron Stultz
google_reviews.text: The owner of this place just openly laughed at my niece when she asked about a payment plan to help afford the cost of her father's funeral service. Absolutely inhumane behavior.

google_reviews.author: Erica Hurst
google_reviews.text: My father-in-law passed away in October and Davies made the entire process so easy and smooth. He was put in hospice on a Monday, we went to Davies that afternoon and met with Narges who was absolutely an incredible human to work with, she walked us through all our options, was gentle, kind and met us where we were emotionally. He passed the next day and the incredible kindness and support we received just the day prior amplified much more through the rest of the process. We were kept informed through every single step and we could not be more thankful to the entire staff but especially to Narges. I cannot imagine how hard it would be to work with grieving families every single day and still be able to maintain such empathy, kindness, love and compassion day in and out. Thank you Davies for being so great to work with. We had a wonderful experience, despite the horrible circumstances and our family could not be more grateful.

google_reviews.author: Sladeroo the Travel Guru
google_reviews.text: I highly recommend this company. They made a dreadful situation easy. In addition their were plenty of options. The lady who helped me was wonderful! Reasonable, affordable and they cover all aspects of a loved one moving forward.  Thank you!!! It’s no wonder why Chat GPT had this company the highest rated! Thank you AI!

google_reviews.author: A Shanafelt
google_reviews.text:
I would not recommend this place for my worst enemy. I called on behalf of my friend who lost her partner suddenly. The 1st phone call the woman didn't listen and kept telling me the hospital would have to have the coroner release him to them even though I told her that he died at home and the ME released him to my friend. I still proceeded because they have great reviews and maybe this woman is having an off day. It got worse. I told her that it was very important they came and picked him up asap because his body was outside on her front porch where people walking by could see. I waited a half hour, no call. I called and the woman said she would light a fire under them. Another half hour and no call. I called again and the woman who answered my call this time couldn't find any record of communication. Are you serious?! I told her that they're not longer needed and hung up. We called Browns who answered and picked him up within 20 minutes of taking my call.

I wouldn't trust them with anyone's loved ones. Do better.

google_reviews.author: Aaron Tuttle
google_reviews.text:
I'm someone who doesn't do many reviews, although this time it's the least I could do to thank everyone at Davies Cremation & Burial. Everyone working at Davies is very professional. They took over and I had very little to worry about in a time of morning confusion and loss of a loved one. Jim the coordinator is a great guy he went way out of his way to make sure my dad got his military burial because we didn't have the paperwork. Jim pulled through for us and I owe him so much thank you Jim. The staff at Davy's location made you feel very very comfortable when you had to come in to the office. My sincerest thank you to all of you!
Aaron Tuttle and Family

google_reviews.author: Gayle Slade
google_reviews.text:
The women who helped me made decisions I dreaded a breeze. I’m ashamed I don’t remember how she spells her name… I Believe Feroaud?

The cost was very reasonable making it extremely affordable with plenty of options. There’s a reason why chat GPT says their the best.

Gayle~

name: Drennan & Ford Funeral Home and Crematory

google_reviews.author: Lillian Smith
google_reviews.text: My niece Crystal recently passed away. The family entrusted her care to Durren and Ford. They did a fantastic job of making sure that the family was well taken care of. When it was time for the viewing to say good bye to this wonderful young woman they where very helpful and very perfessional.  Thank you to Scott for helping my family at what was no doubt a very difficult time for us.

google_reviews.author: Susan Brothers
google_reviews.text: Our daughter died unexpectedly and we went to Drennan and Ford. All the staff was extremely helpful, empathetic and supportive during a very stressful time. They took care of all the details when we didn’t know what to do, even bringing the paperwork to our home. Steve created a beautiful service, Douglas made a lovely memorial video and Scott helped us all along the process. We couldn’t have been treated more kindly.  We will recommend this funeral home to anyone in need.

google_reviews.author: D F Lewis
google_reviews.text:
Drennen Ford came highly recommended and we were not disappointed. From the moment they arrived at my dads house, Scott was professional but also very calming. He helped us understand the whole process. We met with him the following day and that meeting only took a half hour. We signed everything and over the next several days, he kept us informed how things were progressing. Scott was very caring and I cannot say thank you enough. A+++
~ David

google_reviews.author: Joel Yelland
google_reviews.text: This is not a fake review!  A family member has dementia and is expected to die within the year.  We shopped around for funeral homes in the area and settled on this one; I had a good feeling about them pretty soon after talking with them.  Prices were at least comparable and in some cases cheaper than other facilities.  They were straightforward and professional.  When I went back to finalize our decision they were busy but immediately fit me in and we did the necessary paperwork, they told me what the next steps were, and what to expect when their services finally are needed.  In my opinion, there is no need to look any further for funeral arrangements.

google_reviews.author: Catlin helle
google_reviews.text: I have waited over a year to write this. If I could give negitave stars I would. Last March my mother passed in our home. I called Drennan and Ford and they came to retrieve the body. I told them specifically on the phone that my mother's dying request was that I be in the room while she was cremated. I was told it was not a problem. I spoke to them again when they came to my house. Again ,not a problem. I was devastated a few days later when they called to tell me I could pick up my mother's ashes. When I went in to speak to the manager he literally hid from me. The owner was callous and horrible and unwilling to take responsibility.Unless you want your loved ones body completely abused and mistreated do not use these people.

google_reviews.author: Alissa
google_reviews.text:
When my mom went into hospice we talked to Earth Funeral Home about end of life plans.  When she passed they came and got her very quickly even though it was the middle of the night.  My only complaint about the whole thing was that it took over a month for them to have space for her, however, they were very good at communicating with us.  They sent several tubes for my aunts to have at my mom's memorial out-of-town and they were lovely.  Overall it was lovely service, and now we all have plants in my mom's memory.

(pictured the containers they shipped for us)

google_reviews.author: Debby Icide
google_reviews.text: The most ecological and giving way that takes care of you after your death.  Turn into soil, so then you nurture a forest in need of regeneration because of overuse.  Give back to it, and leave nothing detrimental behind.

google_reviews.author: Connie Winter
google_reviews.text: The presentation that Earth Funeral puts on is very thorough and informative.  It is comforting to have this decision taken care of, and to be able to feel good about its environmental ramifications.  I don't understand how my local ferry system will assist people in dumping toxic cremation remains into our waterways to harm the marine life.  We, as a culture, need to value our planet more and work to be better stewards of it.  Earth Funeral can be a part of that.  The staff does not use high pressure techniques, and are eager to answer any questions.

google_reviews.author: Jill Viglione
google_reviews.text:
I recently helped a dear friend register for an Earth Funeral, and from the very first step, the experience was incredibly positive. Earth Funeral offers a truly beautiful service—natural burial that transforms remains into soil, which is then returned to the earth in protected forests.

Once registered, my friend received a clear, informative packet that explained everything and answered all of her questions. The customer service team was outstanding—kind, responsive, and deeply respectful throughout the process.

When my friend passed, we simply called. Their team arrived with warmth and compassion, treating my friend with such care and dignity. Afterward, I was kept informed at every stage. I especially appreciated having a single point of contact who guided me through everything with sensitivity and clarity.

When the soil was ready, they even asked how many containers I would like to receive. It’s small details like that which show how thoughtful and personal their service truly is.

I can't recommend Earth Funeral highly enough. They made a difficult time easier, and gave us the comfort of knowing my friend’s final wishes were honored in the most natural and respectful way possible.

google_reviews.author: Susan G
google_reviews.text: What a wonderful concept and company!  I’m so glad I found Earth Funeral.  I was looking for a green alternative to end of life when I came across this company.  I attended their webinar and took a tour of the facility.  The employees were so kind and patient.  This is a big decision and they were so compassionate.  I’ve recommended this to family and friends and it’s sparked interest with them.   Traditional funerals are so archaic and unfriendly to our environment.  I’m so glad I found Earth Funeral and recommend you investigate this end of life option!

google_reviews.author: Judith Davies
google_reviews.text: We have used Edline Yahn for both our parents, 2016 and 2022. Their service is impeccable and they make this challenging time very easy to navigate. I felt supported throughout and would recommend any of my family and friends to them. They also have a beautiful chapel for viewing and plenty of parking for your guests. Excellent service and staff is remarkably sensitive and present. Thank you Roxanne, the funeral director, for all you did for our family.

google_reviews.author: Carol Jones-Mine
google_reviews.text:
I was very pleased with the services here. I was treated with compassion and understanding. The process was very simple and they helped to make the transition without my loved one so much easier than expected.

The staff was professional and caring, and was available to help me with any questions I had. I’m grateful to have had the opportunity to find a place that treated my loved one with dignity and care the way that they did.

google_reviews.author: MaidenMinnie Memories
google_reviews.text: On behalf from my family and I, we would like to extend our appreciation to the funeral director of Edline-Yahn and Covington Funeral Chapel, Mr. Leland Loftis; for his warm and supportive sympathy of my Father’s demise. The funeral arrangements from day 1 until my Father’s burial day was professionally well done. He lead us in an organized manner from all the necessary arrangements to making our Father’s funeral respectively with great regards. He coordinated with Veteran’s Service’s and our choice of Catholic funeral church services. We appreciate Leland and funeral coordinator Tiffany for accommodations of their beautiful Chapel for my Father’s memorial mass and viewing. Greatly appreciate your kindness, patience, understanding and sympathy during our family’s sorrow of losing our dearly departed Father. Much appreciated for the lovely memorial tapestry gift of my Father. Thank you and may you both be blessed with loving care from our Almighty God🙏

google_reviews.author: Jason Clapp
google_reviews.text: Very professional and courteous staff.  They performed the ceremony to perfection and aided in all the planning and production of the funeral service!  James, Roxanne and Racheal were with us the whole way and did an awesome job!  I highly recommend Edline-Yahn & Covington Funeral Chapel for their services during these very hard times.  Thank you guys!

google_reviews.author: Charmaine Nelson
google_reviews.text:
It is a little soon after husband's passing, barely 3 wks ago, but I keep getting this request to rate Edline- Yahn. so first off, maybe wait a decent amount of time before pushing so.eone for a rating?
All I can say, is my initial dealings after husband's passing, with Edline was more stressful than should have been. Hoping this was a training, learning opportunity, and am so grateful for Roxanne who smoothed out issues and was able to clarify things,  was patient, and the strong supportive representative we all need at times like this.
I am confident, when my times comes, Edline Yahn will be there to support my family.

google_reviews.author: Pinkjade77
google_reviews.text:
Edwards is truly the very best!! Don’t hesitate to choose them because they aren’t the typical funeral home business, they are a family doing it as a labor of love for our community!!!

My dad passed in 2018, so I hesitated to write this review at first, but my motto in life is better late than never.

From the beginning when my dad was escorted out of the house into the hands of Edwards, I remember the two gentlemen who are so kind and compassionate. It was like from then on I knew he was in great hands, the right hands.

Everyone at Edwards was kind and compassionate, but Melissa takes the cake! She was the coordinator who worked with me and my mom. She treated me and took care of us like family, she felt like a sister to me! She didn’t work there to collect a paycheck, it was  labor of love for her as with the rest of the Edwards family.

They Forever impacted me and my mom’s life. They touched our hearts. They were the light in the darkness. Thank you again Melissa and Edwards, for your care and dedication to the community!! 💖💖🙏🙏

google_reviews.author: Leesha Kamuta
google_reviews.text: Where to start, I want to say that anyone who is searching for a place to care for their loved one after they pass, you have found it. Marcus & the whole staff at Edwards Memorial Funeral Home in Lakewood went above and beyond. From the day I called to have my mother picked up from the hospital to the meeting to make her arrangements, to her dressing day, to the day she came to the church for the family sharing portion of our family day in celebration of her life, to the day of her burial - they were caring and attentive to our needs and wants. Respected our wishes and made the whole process bare able and stress free. I will recommend them to whoever is looking for a place to care for their loved one and be there to answer your questions and help guide you along the whole process. Marcus is an amazing Funeral Director and the staff there are such amazing people & Lilu (service dog) was the cherry on top- she gave comfort when it was needed the most specially as we waited to do my mother’s dressing and viewing. Comforted my heart knowing we had people caring for my mom and us at the same time. Amazing atmosphere & wouldn’t choose anyone else.

google_reviews.author: Jim O'Hagan
google_reviews.text: Stop in and check these folks out if you wanna see why this place is getting high reviews. I came from out of town (WV) to Puyallup to help sort the details of my wife’s stepfather’s unexpected passing. Someone in his circle recommended this place because it was affordable. That could be seen to mean cheap (in service), a concern I did have until speaking on the phone with them. I called around to about 5 different funeral homes in the area, and while all were professional, they all seemed to have the same script and were not initially forthcoming with what their fees include, until I asked enough questions. These folks here explained exactly what was, and was not included in the various fees before I had to ask. I felt very confident working with this place after the brief call I had with them. My wife and I then met with Anna in person and went over what exactly we were looking for in terms of service and she was not only compassionate and professional, but very down to earth and genuine. Every step of the process was smooth and well communicated. To the employer: hang on to her and give her a raise! This was back in January 2025 (apologies for the late review). I cannot recall the office receptionist ‘s name (she’s got a dog that hangs out there), but she was great as well! Lastly, I ultimately went with this place based on how they carried themselves, not the price tag. As it turns out, the price was in fact the lowest, but the service and peace of mind was exceptional.

google_reviews.author: Vikke Pierson
google_reviews.text: This was my second use of Edwards services in the past 20 years; And it was even better than the first. Lots of options 100% compassionate care great follow up. I recommend them without reservation

google_reviews.author: Domenico Savarino
google_reviews.text:
I lost My wife, in 2021, we started as Highschool sweethearts, 45 yrs, I wanted more. Did a great job.
My son just passed last month, so we will do it again.  Anything good takes time.
Thank you

google_reviews.author: Ricardo Ocana
google_reviews.text: We are most grateful to the staff at Edwards Memorial Funeral Home for providing us with immediate attention, compassionate handling, and a seamless experience during & after our time of need. Thank you so much for your preparation & burial of my dear sister, Catherine. It was as beautiful as it was sad.

google_reviews.author: Karen McMillan
google_reviews.text:
To all at Edwards, thank you for the love, effort and care given to my family.
The incredible group of people that made sure our hearts were given peace in tending to our loved one. Dignified, respectful, and honorable.
Loving arms and caring hearts.
You all are appreciated for your assistance and guidance during our time in need.

Sincerely,
Karen McMillan

google_reviews.author: Georgian Kalow
google_reviews.text:
We retired from Colorado to the Tacoma area to be closer to family. We decided to make sure that our affairs were in order so that our kids would have less to worry about when it came time for our funeral arrangements. That was back in 2018. We chose Edwards Memorial and promptly took care of paperwork and payments.
Fast forward to September of this year. My husband of 52 years passed away.
The whole team at Edwards Memorial was so compassionate, supportive, and helpful to our family. We encountered a few glitches along the way, but Cassie and the staff were there helping and working with us through this difficult time.
I highly recommend Edwards Memorial. Having a company that understands that people need help without pressure during a time when the family is pretty vulnerable is really commendable. They are fair in pricing with lots of options. They also check in with you after the death, just to see how you are doing and give you resources in case you need help. That ranks high in my opinion too.

google_reviews.author: laura PULLEN
google_reviews.text: I had no idea what to do when my dad passed away someone told me to call a funeral home so I did and I'm glad I called this one. I told them my dad wanted to be cremated and they literally took it from there and helped me with everything that needed to be done for that to happen. I really appreciated all the information they gave me to help me put my dad to rest I made the right choice in calling them. They are very accommodating to your wishes and helped me get through all of it. I highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: Mick Crosby
google_reviews.text: The Edwards Memorial staff were awesome in providing emotional support and explaining the essential details involved with the cremation of my wife and our understanding of this process. I would highly recommend them to any family facing the challenges of providing their loved one’s final destination with caring and loving closure!

name: Edwards Memorial Funeral Home - Federal Way

google_reviews.author: Maria
google_reviews.text: Edward Memorial Funeral Home made it easy for me to plan a loved ones funeral arrangements  at a very difficult time. They guided me through the process at a very step. Very caring throughout the process and just like a family member. They also sent brochures and helpful advice for the next steps to process a loved ones affairs.

google_reviews.author: Laura Helton
google_reviews.text:
We cannot say enough about the incredible care and compassion we received from Edwards Funeral Home. Megan, our funeral director, was absolutely amazing. From start to finish, she made us feel supported and truly cared for during one of the hardest times of our lives. From the first call with her it sealed the deal that we were going to utilize this funeral home.

Her kindness, attention to detail, and the way she walked us through every step with patience and compassion made such a difference. It’s clear that being a funeral director is her calling—she was born for this work. Megan went above and beyond to make sure the family felt comforted and that every detail was handled with care.

Edwards Funeral Home is very lucky to have someone like Megan on their team. She deserves major recognition (and a raise!) for the outstanding way she serves families. We will forever be grateful for her support.

google_reviews.author: Jennifer Julian
google_reviews.text: We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The Federal Way location took extra good care of us and our family needs. Even when we underestimated what we needed, Megan stepped up and provided us with exactly what was needed. She got us, who we are, who our Dad was. There aren’t enough stars to rate! 10/10

google_reviews.author: Kodi Crossett
google_reviews.text: Megan was the absolute best in assisting in a difficult time.  As I was not a direct relative  but a close friend I thought the process would be difficult in helping facilitate the end of life process.  One phone call took a huge weight of stress off of our untimely situation and made the entire process so much easier to handle.  The level of knowledge and respect was beyond my expectations & far better than I have had in previous experiences. I have already recommended Edward's Memorial Funeral Home to others.

google_reviews.author: Dakota Pintor
google_reviews.text:
Megan was an incredible support during the heartbreaking loss of our baby boy, Andres. Despite being from out of town, we refused to use any other funeral home, trusting Megan deeply with this fragile moment. She facilitated Andres' cremation swiftly, allowing us to bring him home quickly, which provided us with much-needed peace.

Megan's dedication and emotional support made us feel less alone during this difficult time. We also want to thank her boss, Logan, for empowering her to better serve the community, and Holly, the crematory operator, for assisting in getting precious hand and foot prints of baby Andres before cremation. Megan's fair pricing and exceptional services make her the go-to funeral director in the Federal Way and surrounding communities. We are so grateful for everything she did for us. Thank you, Megan!

google_reviews.author: Richmond Nguyen
google_reviews.text:
Tl;Dr: A local alternative to corporate funeral homes that provides far superior service, and won't treat you as just a number.

My family and I are glad to leave another 5 star review for Emmick's Family Funeral Home. My mother recently passed, and while she was going through comfort care, my family and I were reaching out to various funeral homes since the hospital indicated that they can only hold onto the body for no more than 6 hours. I eventually chose Emmick because it's local and family run, they didn't try to ups3ll and make me feel like I was at a car dealership, and because of the reviews I've read.

Michael helped us at every step of the process, and provided us with options that worked for us. Sure, as a business, they would love it if we chose the most expensive options, but we were never pressed to do so. He gave us the options, and answered our questions when we had any, and further elaborated if there was more information that we should know.

A concern with choosing local over a multistate corporation may be how careful the body is prepared, or how prompt (or not) that the local may be vs the corp, but Emmick did very well with the prep. They were able to garb the body in the culturally appropriate attire that we asked them to, reached out to confirm the look with us, and applied the changes we asked them to. We are very pleased with the final result. We had the funeral shortly after the passing and they were on time and were always able to contacted.

It's too bad that Google's AI can't figure out that when ups3ll is mentioned in these reviews, it is done so in the negative context since the folks at Emmick cater to what your family needs.

A Beacon of Compassion and Professionalism During Our Darkest Time
​We recently entrusted Evergreen Washelli with the care of our beloved mother, and from the moment they took her into their care, they were nothing short of exceptional. During what felt like the darkest and most overwhelming time for our family, their team handled everything with the utmost dignity, warmth, and professionalism.
​The special care they took of my mother after her passing was deeply comforting. We always felt she was being treated with respect. When it came to the arrangements, they were absolutely amazing. They meticulously organized the viewing and the ceremony, taking the burden of logistics completely off our shoulders while ensuring every detail perfectly honored her life. The ceremony itself was beautiful and seamlessly executed.
​A particular highlight was the effort they put into helping me creat the perfect slideshow of my Mom's life for our guests.  However it wasn't just a collection of photos; it was a beautifully compiled, moving tribute that brought her story to life and gave everyone a meaningful way to remember her.
It was clear that the staff cared deeply about making this ceremony personal and special. They even surprised me by ordering small (purple) angel trinkets for keepsakes for our guests.
​Our incredible funeral director, Amity, deserves a special shout-out. She was exceptionally caring, kind, and open with myself and our entire family, making us feel supported every step of the way. The entire staff at Evergreen Washelli went above and beyond, demonstrating genuine empathy while maintaining an unparalleled level of organization. We cannot recommend them highly enough to any family needing funeral services. They were a true blessing and provided the perfect, respectful farewell our mother deserved. Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts.

google_reviews.author: Rosanna Gonzales
google_reviews.text:
I’ve attended the Día de los Muertos celebration at Evergreen Washelli every single year, and somehow it continues to grow more meaningful, more vibrant, and more community-centered with each return. This event is truly one of Seattle’s hidden gems—an experience that brings people together in a way few gatherings manage to do.
What makes it so special is how deeply community-driven it is. Everything—from the ofrendas to the performances—comes directly from local artists, dancers, musicians, and families who care about sharing culture, memory, and creativity. There’s a genuine sense of collaboration: you can feel that this isn’t an event for the community, but one built by the community.
It’s also completely free to attend, which removes barriers and allows everyone, from every background, to participate. You see children, elders, longtime Seattle residents, newcomers—all gathering together, talking, remembering, laughing, and learning. In a time when it’s easy to feel disconnected, this event does the exact opposite: it strengthens bonds.
And every year it just gets better. The art is richer, the performances more moving, the atmosphere more welcoming. It has become one of those rare traditions that brings people back not only for the festivities, but for the feeling of unity it creates.
If you’re looking for an event that celebrates culture, honors loved ones, and lifts up community voices, the Día de los Muertos celebration at Evergreen Washelli is truly something special. I’m already looking forward to next year.

Losing a loved one is an unimaginable experience, but Flintoft's did everything they could to make the funeral home part of it as loving and comforting as possible. From the very first phone call, I knew we were in the right place.
Every single person we interacted with was loving, compassionate, and deeply empathetic. Kelly and Allen were our primary contacts, and they were absolutely phenomenal. They were kind, attentive, and incredibly supportive throughout the entire process. Even when they weren’t available, other staff members stepped in seamlessly to help us. It truly felt like the entire team cared about our family and wanted to make this as smooth and gentle as possible.
They provided a beautiful and peaceful viewing that meant so much to us. Every interaction — from retrieving personal items, to coordinating with the medical examiner, to picking up the ashes and providing the death certificate — was handled with such delicacy and professionalism and they often went above and beyond. They were proactive, organized, and on top of every detail from the very beginning. We never felt like just another family or another case; we felt cared for.

google_reviews.text:
Our family's interaction with Forest Lawn in West Seattle started some time ago.  Our mother passed peacefully in May 2022; then time to make arrangements.  Dad, also 92, tasked himself, with his four kids in support, in making those arrangements.  Both Mom & Dad were more recent transplants to Washington - to be near their kids - and their kids - and their kids.

Firmly rooted in Catholic tradition and his own family history, but with empathetic responses from Forest Lawn and evolving doctrine, Dad selected cremation, and a spot with a great view at an outdoor rose garden and columbarium.  Then Dad's time came in June 2024, and responsibility fell to us - their children.  With Forest Lawn's continued dignified & empathetic counsel, we gathered the extended family, (a bit later in August 2025) shared stories and photos and placed letters to Dad & Mom.  Most of all - enjoyed what our parents' had initiated:  US.

Forest Lawn (Vy & Greg particularly) helped us achieve that peace in transition.  Thank you.

google_reviews.author: Erika Peluso
google_reviews.text:
I wasn't sure how a Covid-era funeral would go. I had really low expectations and didn't think it would really feel right.
The opportunity to mourn outside next to my family and interact with some distance meant more to me than I knew. It rained that day, and they had set up a nice tarp. They put some fake grass down too. That way we weren't stepping on other's graves.
The urn was beautiful. The vault cap was lovely, and the staff were professional and thoughtful. I think Leah was helping us. Perfect demeanor, and she even took a family picture.
Thank you for helping us mourn, and giving us a safe space to grieve together but apart. It made all the difference.

google_reviews.author: Meechele44
google_reviews.text: My experience with Forest Lawn has been easy. They were able to come out fairly promptly, and were very collected, professional; and personable. I would go back to Forest Lawn for future needs if need be. The funeral directors can get busy and sometimes takes a bit to get a phone call/ email back, but I realize they are helping other families in their time of need.

google_reviews.author: Lisa Mohoric

google_reviews.author: Kat Dempsey

google_reviews.author: N Monica Johnston
google_reviews.text:
When my beloved grandmother passed, this funeral home showed our family an extraordinary level of compassion, patience, and professionalism. They handled every step of the process with dignity and care, ensuring her final moments were honored exactly as she deserved. Their kindness and respect brought comfort to our hearts during a time that was almost unbearable.

I want to address the negative review left by my uncle, Roy (Ab Studios) I was deeply saddened to see such a misleading and unfair reflection of this wonderful staff. First and foremost, he was not my grandmother’s only son—she was also the loving mother of my uncle Allen.  The truth is, when he visited my grandmother near the end of her life, he was cold and distant — even my grandmother noticed it and told him, “You are not my son; my son wouldn’t be so cold and distant to me.” His review comes not from grief or love, but from resentment and self-interest. It pains me to have to say this publicly, but I cannot let his false words diminish the good work and compassion this funeral home truly provided.

It’s heartbreaking to see someone attempt to project his own guilt and detachment onto a funeral home that acted with nothing but kindness and integrity.

I would have responded sooner, but the pain of losing her was too heavy for me to revisit until now. However, I cannot stay silent while such falsehoods stand against a team that gave our family so much compassion.

google_reviews.author: CA Elias
google_reviews.text:
Five years ago, during the building construction, my family used HMFH when my mom died. The person was nice. That's all I can say in the positive.

My family had to badger the place to get death certificates. Almost a month later, we finally got them.
Now, a friend's mom passed away. The friend hired HMFH to take care of his mom. Almost a month later, he still has not received the ashes or the death certificates.
Ridiculous.
It takes about a week for the county to process death certificates. The executor/estate Representative needs to get things done.

There is a place near Officers Row that is on top of what needs to be done. Check the newspaper death notices for other places.

I can not recommend Hamilton Mylan.

google_reviews.text: My son and I decided on Harper-Ridgeview after reading their online reviews. It's hard to know who to choose when going through the death of a loved one. We recommend anyone finding themselves needing this kind of service to give them a call. I know as life progresses we will certainly contact them again. My son Brandon and I thank them for being there for us.

google_reviews.author: Geraden Ray

google_reviews.text: A year ago this week my uncle passed away. I called them and they went and picked my uncle up from a different mortuary and took care of everything for me. google_reviews.author: Juliet Mazza
google_reviews.text: I wanted to share about our positive experience with Harrison Family Mortuary! Losing a loved one is never easy, and I will be forever thankful to the Harrison Family staff for helping our family through one of the most devastating times in our lives- the heartbreaking sudden loss of our sweet Momma, and loving wife to my Daddy. The compassionate and professional care we received from HFM made a world of difference during a very difficult time. From the moment we walked through their doors, we were met with warmth, understanding, and respect. Every single member of the staff that we encountered were simply amazing. I know I could not have made it through this without their care and support. Ashley was wonderful to work with on planning the arrangements, and Betony made me feel peace and comfort with how well she took care of my Mom, from helping me choose her nail polish and helping my daughter put a bracelet she had specially made for her grandma on her wrist before the funeral. I don't think I could have left my mom with anyone better. I feel so bad, because I cannot remember the other sweet lady's name at the moment- the kind lady that helped me with my mom's obituary- she gave me such a nice big hug of comfort, and it was like I was getting a hug from my mom which I so desperately needed. These little acts of kindness meant so much to me and my family. HFM took care of every detail of my mom's arrangements with such grace and sensitivity, ensuring that our wishes were honored. They guided us through the process with patience and clarity, answering all our questions and offering gentle reassurance throughout. We never felt any pressure about anything whatsoever. They made it such an easy process. We were dreading having to make these arrangements beforehand, and at the end of our appointment, when we walked outside and got in the car, we breathed such a big sigh a relief and we all felt so thankful and happy that we had found this excellent establishment. The peace we all felt after only reinforced our confidence that we chose wisely. Thank you again, Harrison Family Mortuary, from the bottom of our hearts. God bless you all!

google_reviews.author: Jonna Mondy
google_reviews.text: My family has used Harrison’s several times over the last 13 years and will continue to do so as needed. They are compassionate and clearly communicate their service offerings as well as what to expect from them. They are an extremely caring and professional group of people.

name: Haven Of Rest Funeral Home & Memorial Park

google_reviews.author: Jim Quast
google_reviews.text: Awful! My parents were to be buried June 30th and our family could only attend if we purchased a grave side service..so we did.  We were told their would be a canopy and chairs set up.  We scheduled for 2pm but when we arrived nothing was set up.  My mothers engraved urn tag was missing.  We were not allowed to place urns in ground as planned. Many family/relatives had brought fresh blooms for everyone to place on top urns…that was not allowed.  Instead blooms were placed into white vault tubs. When things were finally set up we were given a small tent covering and they placed the wrong flower spray and had to go find the correct spray. If we had known urns could not be placed into ground I think we would have requested use of chapel vs grave side…chapel would have been cooler, easier for elders and more than half the cost.  I spoke to Kathy whom said she was sorry we were not given all the facts.  So very sad. J Follow up to previous post…owners reached out and were very compassionate and wanted to make things right.  We are very impressed with their dedication! J

google_reviews.author: K C
google_reviews.text:
NOT THIS YEAR.
I am upset and deeply saddened that The LAST and ONLY way we can celebrate a holiday with our dead son has been taken away from us. For 5 years I have mothered my dead son buried at Haven of Rest by decorating the bench We paid for and was installed at our son's grave. But, NOT THIS YEAR. This year we have learned Any and All decorations and treasures will be removed. Only flowers placed in the in-ground planter or a 6 inch pot on the marker are allowed. I am understanding of requirements to allow for landscaping maintenance during the grass growing season, but not allowing us to decorate the bench we purchased or place wreaths during the winter just hurts us. A sterile and bare cemetery is not comforting.  Disappointing Haven of Rest, extremely disappointing.

google_reviews.author: Charles Kienbaum

google_reviews.author: Summer Cushman
google_reviews.text: I just wanted to send a quick message of gratitude. These last few weeks have been so hard for our family. But Trent Nielsen of Hennessey made one of the hardest parts so much easier. He is clearly gifted in his work. His quiet compassion and strong capability was deeply felt and appreciated. Thank you.

google_reviews.author: Burke Driscoll
google_reviews.text: Summer did such a great job of helping my family plan every aspect of my father’s funeral service. We did a Catholic mass, a reception and an internment, which meant hundreds of details to work out. She helped me put together a tribute video that everyone absolutely loved. The whole thing was such a great way to honor my father and Summer was a huge part of pulling it together.

google_reviews.author: Ki Nassauer
google_reviews.text: Summer was our funeral director and guided us through an incredibly difficult time with compassion and professionalism. She was caring, attentive, and always quick to respond to my many questions. Her calm presence and support made a hard process so much easier. I am so grateful we chose Hennessey.

google_reviews.author: Lisa
google_reviews.text:
I cannot begin to express my gratitude for the compassion, kindness, and genuine care shown by Nate Calvert Funeral Director and Embalmer during one of the hardest times of my life. He guided our family through every step of planning my beloved son’s viewing and Celebration of Life with such empathy and understanding.

His warmth and professionalism brought comfort when we needed it most. He listened, cared, and made sure every detail was handled with love and respect. It was clear he truly cared—not just about his work, but about our family and honoring my son’s memory in the most beautiful way.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for helping us through this unimaginable time with grace, patience, and compassion. You will never know how much that meant to us.

With heartfelt gratitude,
Lisa Quinlivan and Family

google_reviews.author: Jill Kjose
google_reviews.text: During one of the worst times in my sister‘s life, losing her husband of 40 years, Allie was the most warm, caring, and compassionate person I’ve ever met. She provided us with everything we needed to get through this challenging time. She was thorough and informative, but most of all, she provided a level of comfort to us, ensuring that everything was going to be taken care of, and that everything was going to be all right. She made herself available to us 24/7 with any questions thoughts or concerns that we had. She even made personal calls to my sister at home to check in on her during this devastating loss in her life. Her comforting hugs, prayers and scriptures that she shared with us, reassured both my sister and myself that Hennessey Valley Funeral Home  was the place to bring our dearly beloved for his smooth transition home. Thank you Allie for your undeniable commitment to an obvious passion you have deep within your heart. Many blessings. Jill Kjose.

google_reviews.author: Terri McNeilly
google_reviews.text:
My experience started with a simple phone call during a very difficult time in my life. I lost my husband of 39 years to cancer. He was my partner, my love, and my life. I had no experience with such a crushing and devastating loss.

While he was in hospice care, I made several calls to different funeral homes and cremation facilities. I needed information about what to do, costs, and how to proceed. Two of those calls were to Hennessey Funeral Home north and valley. My stress and worry were comforted the minute I heard Allie Greens voice at Hennessey Valley Funeral Home.

Allie immediately put me at ease. She was very patient, respectful, empathetic, and a complete blessing! She is a beautiful sole. She made a very difficult time and process, bearable. She graciously answered all of my questions and concerns with no pressure or concern for money or paperwork.

Upon my husband's passing she gently walked me through the process with genuine care and concern. She again,  answered all of my questions and thoughtfully listened to my personal history and reasoning for a scatter urn. She helped me make a decision on a scatter urn and even a pocket urn. She even offered to special order a urn based on our favorite pass time that she heard me speak about. I don't know if I could have gotten through this without her help and compassion. She even provided me with social security information and a business and financial checklist of things I would need to take care in the days ahead. Allie Green is a godsend. She is an absolute professional that genuinly cares about her job and her consumer. Thank you Allie Green and Hennessey Valley Funeral Home for helping me through this journey.

google_reviews.author: Darren Carpenter
google_reviews.text: I want to start off by thanking Hennessey. Their entire team is phenomenal and super respectful. I had the pleasure of working with Allie she was kind and so supportive. I unfortunately lost two family members this year and I went to Hennessey to get them cremated. The support and love they showed me was so comforting, especially during this hard time I was having. I am very thankful for having Hennessey there to help me. They really do care. Allie you're an incredible human and I appreciate everything you did for me and my family.

google_reviews.author: Lyonell
google_reviews.text: Words cannot express how amazing Hennessey Valley Funeral Home is. They've handled both of my parents funerals and each and every time, they have gone above and beyond for me and my family. Mr. Trent Nielsen has always handled my arrangements with compassion and was always patient with me with everything I was struggling to handle. Each and every one of their staff members have made me and my family feel like we were the only ones they were catering to, and that is something I've never found anywhere else. Ever. I am truly grateful for everything they've done to make sure my parents funerals were beautiful and unforgettable. Thank you Mr. Trent and staff, I will always come back to you for all of my family's needs when the time comes.

When my husband picked up his dad he casually asked about his weekend and told him about his golfing.. This may be another day for you Matt but it’s not for us or our family. The bedside manner was absolutely horrid and insensitive and our wishes weren’t even carried out and we had to wait even longer for them to be fixed. google_reviews.text:
Marce, on behalf of my siblings and myself, I want to thank you for all your assistance in honoring my brother’s final wishes. The unusual circumstances of being more than 3,000 miles away greatly heightened my anxiety—until I made my first phone call to Einan’s at Hillcrest-Pasco.

google_reviews.text: Marce and her crew at Einan's at Hillcrest in Pasco were so helpful and made every detail go so smoothly when it was time to do my Dad's end of Life services.  They even did a couple of favors for me. I highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: Thomas McKeel
google_reviews.text:
Tom Harvey, family, and colleagues are amazing.  They were extremely compassionate, patient, respectful, and went above and beyond in helping us with the process of a complicated death.  Here's what happened:  my sister-in-law Martha died suddenly at the age of 33 while studying for her PhD in Vancouver, BC, Canada.  Almost all of her family live in Colombia, South America.  My wife, Martha's only sister, and I live in North Carolina, USA.

Martha's mom wanted to see her daughter one last time before cremation, but did not have a travel visa to go to Canada and the process for a travel visa in Colombia would take weeks; time we all did not have.  We sought out a funeral home in Seattle.  We made many calls to many different funeral homes and with just a phone call, Mr. Tom Harvey impressed us so much with a gentle and reassuring demeanor.  He patiently guided us through a process that we had never had to deal with before.  He was very available by phone and email, responded promptly, and was flexible with our constantly developing situation.

Mr. Joseph Harvey went to pick up Martha's body from Vancouver to return to Seattle.  They were honest about how she may look for her final viewing before cremation but also did excellent in making her presentable to our family.  Mr.  Tom stayed in house and available during the viewing if we needed anything.  After the cremation, Mr. Joseph was so kind and compassionate with Martha's remains and explaining to us what we needed to do to have her remains flown back to Colombia.  Through 3 countries and across 2 continents, we could not have asked for better facilitators.

My one regret is that Harvey Funeral Home is so far away from us in Seattle; if I or any of my family needed such services again, we could not imagine going anywhere else.  Thank you from the bottom of our hearts and I wish every good thing is this life comes to you; for what you do helps and heals more than you may ever know.

google_reviews.text:
Tom has always done an outstanding job
for my family.  We have used his services five times over the years and  and have been well satisfied.  Tom Langdon

I went through Island Funeral Services in August of 2024 when my father passed. They were highly unprofessional from start to finish.

When coming to pick up the deceased, the owner and her adult son almost dropped my father (an average size man) multiple times, eventually enlisting my fiancé to make an emergency catch of the remains/gurney. The owner ghosted me for multiple weeks at a time and lied to me about how long it would take and how to access the death certificate (it took over two months through their business). Eventually a relative of my family went to the court house and informed me I could've walked in and used a kiosk to buy copies of the death certificate weeks ago, which the owner refused to tell me while continuing to not give me the copies I had already paid for and was promised weeks before.

It is now July 2025 and I just had to request that same adult son to leave my workplaces private parking lot because he was playing with fireworks. This man had the nerve to be argumentative and to bring up my dead father when I was just doing my job. I am not one to typically write bad reviews or file complaints but this was my limit. I'm glad I kept receipts of my communications with this business (and their lack of responses) as will be reporting to the better business bureau.

He made great suggestions and was so kind.  He even hunted down a source for a glass art ornament made from a bit of my husband’s ashes.  Henry and his crew are priceless, important members of our community making the hardest of days a bit easier.  I recommend Johnston & Williams and cannot imagine going through this process with any else.  You may start as strangers, but you will find a true friend in Henry.

google_reviews.text: Ken funeral home helped put together my brothers funeral service.The moment i got together with sarah perry it was a lift from my shoulders, she helped with death certificates, scheduling a and service it nice to know that they care, and listen to are your needs. other funeral homes when you step in see you as a money maker, no thanks. kern funeral is the best in the valley they are they only ones who offer grief support also.

google_reviews.text:
Kern Funeral Home handled the burial of my baby boy's ashes (he had been cremated elsewhere before I moved here). I was not able to let his ashes go for a long time, and I called twice and then changed my mind. They never pushed me. The third time, I was ready, and they were very good at respecting my wishes, and internment was cheaper than other places. I wanted baby buried before what would've been his 2nd birthday, and we managed to do that December 10, 2020. His marker ended up going missing, and they tracked it down for me.

Now I am in the process of pre-planning and it is a very simple and easy process, they are respectful of my wishes and what I want for my own funeral when the time comes and what I want to happen.

google_reviews.text:
John Heatherington is a true advocate, one who will walk alongside of you.

He has made this time of transition one of the most stress free and enjoyable experiences as it could be. He works with hospice and so was able to just receive a call from them and picked up my husband promptly. Then he sat down and helped me make the arrangements that were awesome and very affordable for me. I knew all the services and costs involved in advance. I'm extremely grateful for his demeanor and knowledge.  It was just a welcome ability to meet such a wonderful human being.

Today I just was able to bring the urn up and he transferred my husband's ashes over to the urn and it was properly labeled.

Completely just stress free, pleasant experience today. Certainly a lot less money than other relatives encured who have recently passed away, or purchased their plans.

Lemley Chapel has the highest rating. 10 stars, if possible. They have full service. But what I appreciated was that many extras were included at no cost or very low cost. So for example, i was able to get the death certificates at just the rate that the state charges for them. I got  them in the mail in days, which was nice for making appointments with life insurance agent
(Two weeks faster than what he expected.) The Lemley staff also notified the social security for me right away. So that was another burden off my mind.

If you have a need for Lemley services, you don't have to worry about looking for other places, because Lemley were at top ranking among others in the area for affordability and types of services available. This includes full chapel services, viewings, services with coordinated music and preachers, video remembrances, guest notification, website remembrance page and more.

They just have a lot to offer and with people like John, I am so so grateful for the opportunity to have him at my side.

google_reviews.text: I am very blessed to have worked with Lewis Funeral Chapel. The most caring and genuine experience from meeting Naomi when she picked up my grandmother for transportation where she passed to my meeting this morning with Margaret. Lewis Chapel has hired the right people for their team and I will feel forever blessed for their services. My only regret is not using them for my mother's passing last year. google_reviews.author: Juli Hewitt
google_reviews.text:
September 2024 i went down to order 4 gravestones. And worked with Lynn, I was to bury my mother, my father and my little brother, who died tragically and to prepay for my funeral. She asked if I had a lawyer and a will. And I said, no, and explain that the last lawyer that I hired when I adopted my father, who had less than 6 months to live. And since I wouldn't clean out his account and shove him in a nursing home, he gained temporary POA through the courts. And I was not able to talk to my father again. She called me the next day and said oh we have $2700 that was left over that they had sat on for over 6 years. And she said we tried to contact you, and I said, that's not true. You contacted me the day before.Thanksgiving, as my father died on 11 11 2018 i needed my signature to cremate him. I was not allowed to see the body. So they cremated him on Thanksgiving Day after I signed the papers and I picked him up the day after Thanksgiving. She said, well, we'll just take it off the charges for the 4 headstones and the burial. The gravestones arrived february 21 and then my house was split down the middle on February 25th so I went down and talked to Dee, and she said, oh, your father has already been buried. And I said, whose Ashes do I have i asked Dee to have the director please call me and explain why. They kept the money for over 6 years. Nobody called and nobody will.
So my gravestones are still sitting there and I don't know whose remains I have, still no phone call. So I really don't know what to do. There are horrible people. They have lied.taking my money and not followed through on the burial. As far as I'm concerned, all I want to do is bury my family. Then, I cannot trust them to bury me. When I pass, as i'm sixty six years old, and i'm ready to die. And I'm supposed to trust this company to bury me when I'm gone. Which, at this time is gonna be sooner than later? And nobody will help me, including this funeral home so I will find another funeral home. That does care about people and take care of business. Go ahead and keep the money since you won't call me and explain. If losing my family wasn't tragic enough to have this uncaring business treat me with no respect and no answers and no phone calls. But they sure took my money. So if you want to stop by, you can see my family's gravestones, they've been sitting there for a year and a 1 and I'm in a loss of what to do. Because I have a plot at the silverdale cemetery and that's the last thing on my list. I have to do before I die. I guess so I can say through tears is shame on you for being so mean and unkind and uncaring
