google_reviews.text: I highly recommend Lifetime Celebrations by Washelli. The staff is both professional and accommodating, ensuring a smooth and respectful experience. I want to give special recognition to Funeral Director Venice Harris-Quade, whose support and guidance were invaluable from the moment I inquired about pricing. On the day of the service, she went above and beyond to make sure the chapel was immaculate and thoughtfully arranged, and she made sure our chosen playlist was played exactly as we requested.

google_reviews.author: Eric Turner
google_reviews.text: I was arranging mortuary services in a situation where a simple cremation was the best option. Although Lifetime offers a wide range of services, they did not try to upsell me, they understood my situation.  The related paperwork was processed very quickly. This is necessary to obtain the death certificate, and start legal matters related to the estate.  I have worked with another mortuary in the past where this took over a month, instead of around a week at Lifetime.  So, the key points of service were excellent.  The staff was attentive, professional, and caring.  In this situation I would use them again without a doubt.

google_reviews.author: Jennifer Lemus
google_reviews.text:
Venice and the team at Lifetime Celebrations were wonderful.  They handled the first part of the arrangements for my father who was to be cremated here in WA State and then remains sent to a mortuary in California, and then handled for his final resting.  I thought it would be rather complicated, but it was not.  Venice walked me through everything, handled all of the details with respect and dignity and was very communicative to the team down in California.

One thing that I really want to commend is the evening my Father did pass, at his Adult Family Home, Felix from Lifetime Celebrations was the person who collected my Father, he was so respectful and was very polite and wanted to make sure we had proper time to be alone with him or do any blessings.  He was also explaining to me each step he was taking and what he would be doing.  I thought he was lovely and made a very sad and highly emotional moment very peaceful. I thank him for that.

google_reviews.author: Amy Vangemert
google_reviews.text:
When it matters most, compassion and exceptional service is most important. Especially when grieving the loss of a loved one! We lost our Mother three weeks ago today and I never could imagine I would be writing a review.
Lifetime Celebrations by Washelli deserves it!

Thank you to Venice Harris-Quade, Funeral Director. She is truly one of a kind! She was professional, caring, soft spoken and has a way of comforting you during such an emotional process. She has a way making the worst experience a beautiful one.

During the viewing we met Terran, the crematory operator. Wasn’t expecting it but I took note of his presence. He was extremely respectful!
I can imagine that his job could be very stressful and yet his presence at this time was so appreciated and ceremonial like.
Thank you Terran.

Thank you Lifetime Celebrations for all you do for families during a most vulnerable time in life.
🙏❤️

google_reviews.author: nancy paquin
google_reviews.text: The people at Lifetime Celebrations were very helpful and very attuned to what we needed and also importantly, what we didn't need. We were very pleased with how they helped us and would recommend them to anyone who faces this difficult task.

google_reviews.author: Donna Nichols
google_reviews.text:
Ten Stars!
Linde-Price was a perfect fit for our needs.
Amber(funeral director)was such a comfort and so much help with setting up my mom’s celebration of life.  We had no clue where to begin.
Amber helped us through the whole process.
We used their service room and were able to bring our flowers, tables, posters, slide show monitor and music.  Amber even introduced us to the best minister we could ever get, Kathi Gregoir.   The entire day went smoothly and it was a beautiful tribute to our mom’s life.
Back to Amber; I have never met a sweeter, more compassionate individual.
She is knowledgeable and more than hospitable to deal with and she was always there with a hug when I asked for one.
I hope I live a long life but when the lord calls me home, I want Linde-Price and Amber to be involved.
Also big kiddos to Heather who was also super kind and helpful to us.

google_reviews.author: Christina Barbour
google_reviews.text: Heather at Linde-Price funeral services was the most wonderful woman we have ever met. She was so kind, thoughtful, considerate, reassuring, sympathetic, I could go on forever about how amazing she was to us! The funeral home is very reasonably priced and very friendly. If anyone is in need of these services I highly recommend these guys. They were very professional and answered all the questions we had. They made this process simple and as painless as possible. I brought my toddlers with me to pick up my Dad's ashes, and they brought out toys for them to play with while we signed the paperwork and went over everything. We thank them from the bottom of our hearts for everything they did for us❤️

google_reviews.author: Emma Mendenhall
google_reviews.text: Professional care that went above and beyond and at a reasonable price. They helped me take care of my Mom and felt like family.

google_reviews.author: S Gordon
google_reviews.text: Amber at Linde Price Funeral Service in Sequin,WA was extremely helpful in our process of making arrangements for an elderly relative. Amber handled all questions thoroughly, in a professional and friendly manner. Their service area is all Olympic peninsula, Kitsap County and even Tacoma/Seattle!  Would highly recommend Linde Price Funeral Service of Sequim!

google_reviews.author: Ken Lewis
google_reviews.text: Very caring staff, prompt service and response, and reasonable pricing. We pre-arranged my mother’s service and were very pleased with these folks when the time came for their help. After working with a different local funeral home for another family member’s passing recently, it became apparent that Linde-Price should’ve been our first choice before. People make the difference, and the staff’s compassion and diligence reflected their respect for our family and loved one.

google_reviews.author: C M
google_reviews.text: Joanna has a very strong, rude, unprofessional manner. I arrived at the cemetery asking questions about a situation pertaining to my brothers bench being destroyed and according to her she didn't have a clue to what happened to it when it was destroyed in broad daylight. In reality she knew the WHOLE time who did it and could have avoided putting my family and I under emotional distress! From the rest of the comments as well it seems like Joanna isn't very professional in her job which makes no sense because having the job she has you'd think she would be more considerate of grieving families.

google_reviews.author: Martin Mungia
google_reviews.text: Have had several issues with secretary Joanna not giving the family and I straight answers about issues pertaining to our loved one who has passed, having his headstone being knocked down off its base and now his bench being broken in broad daylight on February 19th, 2020. Joanna claimed not knowing any information about the situation when I spoke to her but then she recanted her story and told my ex-wife that she had information about the person who did it. She has no professional communication skills whatsoever, she was very rude and untruthful about the situation as well. Been trying to contact the owners and no answer!

google_reviews.author: John Clark
google_reviews.text: The first part of April I called inquiring about picking out a grave site. I was told they would look for a suitable spot and would call me back. I never received a call back. About 1 week later I called them again and was able to secure an appointment on a Thursday at 9:00 am. When I got there at the scheduled time the sign on the office door said not open until 9:30. Another couple was also scheduled at 9:00 am. An employee finally showed up 10 minutes late at 9:40. I asked her why she scheduled two people at 9:00 am when the office isn’t even opened until 9:30? She ignored me and didn’t want to hear me. When I approached the door of the office to enter she said “I don’t know you.” I told her I had a 9:00 am appointment, then proceeded to shut the door in my face. So much for just wanting to talk about a grave site.

google_reviews.author: Denora Sandoval
google_reviews.text: I have found it necessary to edit my review that I posted over a year ago.  My beautiful little angel (my daughter) has been buried there since 2016 and we just buried another beautiful angel in April of this year (my beautiful grand-daughter in the lullaby land)Me and my family have had on two different occasions problems with black tire marks on my little ones headstone broken lights, personal photos removed etc., then on my grand baby's plot (she does not have a stone) things have been disposed.  Both times I called and spoke to whoever the gal is in the office and basically she did not want to hear what I had to say but took it upon herself to yell over the phone talk over me and basically said read the rules.  I am upset that whoever hired her and the maintenance people have no respect for keeping the grounds up grass cut but continue to drive over stones and plots without any consideration at all.   My son and my daughter (who is the mother of the grand-baby buried in the lullaby land also called and received the same poor treatment.  I have read the rules and understand them, but you cannot allow some people to have certain things and others not on their loved ones headstones and/or plots. Their conduct and mannerism was so unprofessional.  If this continues to happen I will be filing a formal complaint.  I know that I am not the only concerned citizen who has loves ones buried at this cemetary.  I was trying to reach the owner but decided to edit my previous review to see if he will reply. He needs to know the kind of people he hired are not caring nor considerate and something needs to be done.  This is such a sacred place and things like this should not be happening and people should not be treated without respect and courtesy.  I have pictures that my son took but I am having trouble uploading them.  I will post them hereafter.

google_reviews.author: Uriel Barajas
google_reviews.text:
It has been almost a year since I buried my lovely mom in this cemetery , and paid for the headstone
to Joanna. After 6 months I went to inquire on the head stone, she told me it might take about 3 or 4 more months
before the company sent it. I went back again in August of this year to talk to her since I did not hear from her,
in the last 5 months. I was able to to tell she got a bit upset about me showing up to the office again
she told me I need to learn how to wait and to understand because of covid, they were behind on everything.
I then asked her for the company or the owners  of the cemetery phone number and she refused to provide me with  any number for me to call.
she then asked me to leave and  she would call the company for me promising she would give me answers!!!
she then called me  about   20 minutes later after I left   and told not to call or come into the office again
because she thinks that the company with the headstone might not longer exist but she would try to find out for sure and then call me
to let me know.

google_reviews.author: Ruby Nagra-Basi
google_reviews.text:
It was my first time doing a funeral and having to arrange for everything. I have to say that they were very helpful and helped us through the process. I originally spoke to Karl over the phone and explained to me the process and how the Sikh funerals work and cost estimate.
Kim worked with our family upstairs while we sorted out details.
After my grandmother passed away I called them and we were arranging the funeral.
They spent the time needed and walked us through the process.
Also before viewing we were able to do touch up’s to grandmas makeup. They have hair products, makeup, pins and all.
Again I met Karl Marlatt who was absolutely wonderful.
Only issue I had was with the slideshow which didn’t work for us. The live video did end up getting set up and the family was able to see from afar. Again I highly recommend this funeral home and they are caring and understanding at your time of need.
Thanks again guys!

google_reviews.author: Mele Pele
google_reviews.text:
We thank you Karl Marlatt & Staffs from the bottom of our hearts for taking care my sister’s funeral on March 17, 2025. You and staffs make our funeral service so special. You really went out of your way to help us plan our beloved Sister’s funeral. Thank you for all of your help, assistance, guidance, flexibility, and accommodations during the planning and service. God bless you all!

Thank you!
With heartfelt thanks,

google_reviews.author: Rayven P
google_reviews.text: I only have positive and amazing things to say about my experience at Marlatt Funeral Home. My family and I were lucky enough to work with Melissa who was patient and great to work with from start to finish. She helped answer all our questions leading up to the date. Our friends and family said the entire service was beautiful. We were also able to live stream the event which was really special for our out-of-state family. Marlatt has great pricing and even better staff. You can tell that they really care about the people they work with. I will always be grateful that they helped give my mom the celebration she deserved.

google_reviews.author: Mitch Jennings
google_reviews.text: I talked to the most incompetent person at the funeral home twice now! Kim Brown is either too old or not patient enough to be a good at his job. I hope that he is replaced as soon as possible if not just fired for his incompetence….. some people just need to retire!

google_reviews.author: Charles Lidtka
google_reviews.text: We are deeply grateful for the kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail provided by Marlatt Funeral Home for our mother.  Every staff member treated our family with compassion and care, making a difficult time a little easier. Karl was especially great to work with—his warmth, patience, and care helped bring us much comfort all the way through.  We truly appreciate their support and highly recommend them to anyone in need of such services.

name: McComb & Wagner Family Funeral Home and Crematory

google_reviews.author: Kaley Mackie
google_reviews.text: The most wonderful experience during a time of great sadness for my family. Marie was wonderful, the staff was so courteous and discreet. They treated my loved one with respect and took care of every small detail. I would recommend them to everyone.

google_reviews.author: Sherry Robinson
google_reviews.text: I called them after my husband passed and they showed such compassion and helped me through the process. They never pressured me into anything. We had my husband cremated and got his hand print done in a kit we had bought they did that at no extra cost to me. We purchased jewelry so we would always have a part of him with us. I would highly recommend them. I thank them for being by my family side and guiding us along the way. Tammy and Megan were great.

google_reviews.author: Walter Chandler
google_reviews.text: Fantastic people, harmony is an angel!!! They took care of my mother and are now taking care of my father, the most compassionate understanding and helpful people!!! They truly turned a nightmare around in mere hrs praise be to the honest caring souls left in this messed up dollar driven world.  I cannot give enough praise to them more so Harmony she truly is an angel thank you so much for the personal attention you gave during this difficult time you cannot be praised enough thank you so very much for all you do in the worst of times for families you truly are a shining star in times of darkness. Their Service is above and beyond!!! I cannot say thank you enough for all you do

google_reviews.author: Debra Kalles
google_reviews.text: They took care of my husband when he passed. They had to pick him up from a different funeral home. I didn't have paper to get flag. But they maked sure he had one. Treated my 2kids and myself without trying to over sell stuff to us.

google_reviews.author: Glenda Sewell
google_reviews.text: I used their services for my mother and son. Excellent services for both. Both were treated with respect and loving care.

name: McComb & Wagner Family Funeral Home and Crematory

google_reviews.author: Wendy Rich-Soto, Realtor
google_reviews.text: My experience with Brooke could not have been better!  She went above and beyond my expectations in every way.  From the care in preparing my father to all of the background paperwork and helping to get him back to California.  I am extremely grateful and feel blessed that He was in your care.  I placed my trust in you and you did not disappoint us.  Thank you dear Brooke.  May you continue to do well and know what you do and what you did matters.  Sincerely the family of Jeff Rich

google_reviews.author: Alexis Bell
google_reviews.text:
Brooke and her husband were wonderful in taking care of my grandfather. Her compassion and taking care of detail is unmatched during such a sad time. On behalf of myself and my family, thank you guys for making a hard day a lot easier.
RIP Harold Bill Corwin, loving husband, dad, friend, and papa.

google_reviews.author: Kimberly Wheeler (Kimi)
google_reviews.text:
Brooke went above and beyond for my family when my sister passed recently. The sincere compassion and delicate care she showed for my family will never be forgotten.
Not only did she make our arrangements with professional ease, she gave us comfort knowing the care she gave our beloved family member.
It can be very difficult and painful to make these arrangements during times such as this. Brooke’s natural kindness made all the difference when we were there.
The tender care she gave to my sister was remarkable. She even went above and beyond with memorial ideas and personal keepsakes.
Thank you Brooke for all that you do, not only for the families, but the care you showed our loved ones that have passed. Words cannot express our gratitude and appreciation!!
I highly recommend her to anyone that’s needing her services. Thank you once again not only from me but from my family.

google_reviews.author: Luke Baugh
google_reviews.text:
5 million stars for this place because they were just so kind and thoughtful throughout this time of my dads passing. Brooke was my point of contact and from the evening that my father passed away they took care of everything, and I just felt the whole time that they were allowing things to happen at our speed, and it never once felt like a business transaction (although their level of transparency with billing is admirable).

What they have is something more than professionalism; its a level of awareness and compassion. It felt to me, after my dad died, that the whole world was going so fast and people were like "OH I'm so sorry" and that is wonderful :) but when I would have trouble sleeping or just in a dark place I would walk in there and whatever staff member I made contact with would come in to greet me and I just instantly felt like "oh, they know"... and that was something that really was needed for me. I just left there and the last person even said "don't hesitate to call if you need anything". It was just such a human interaction. I appreciate it, so much.

They have been in the valley a long time (I remember seeing this place as I went to High School at CHS and it is near there); there's a sense of stability with the staff and the location itself (the building is made of rock).

There's a light hearted pragmatism with the way Brooke leads you through the process (at least with me) and it was just what I needed. I had a lot of curiosities and questions about the cremation process and she was very open, but not pushy... very kind.

I am very thankful for this place... their experience, grace, and understanding is evident. They are not expensive by any means, and I think we got a really good deal for the services they provide.

I appreciate Merchant Funeral Home and while this was my first such experience and haven't had much to compare it to, I recommend you reach out to them if you are in a situation like my family was in.

google_reviews.author: Karen Pell
google_reviews.text: Brooke was so professional and comforting to our family. Excellent service.

google_reviews.author: Christina Marvin
google_reviews.text: Miller Woodlawn Funeral Director Lily Walovich was a compassionate and empathetic guide for our family as we were dealing with great loss. She presented our options clearly and without pressure, giving us time to discuss what we wanted and answering any questions we had. The dignity with which we were treated throughout the entire process by Lily and the Miller Woodlawn staff was remarkable. Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Household McLean
google_reviews.text: At a time that was absolutely devastating, Paul and his team were compassionate, trustworthy, gentle and patient with me as we walked through the steps to cremate my sister. Phone calls were always answered or promptly returned. Everything was done swiftly and with attention to detail. Paul went above and beyond to serve my family and his kindness will never be forgotten.

google_reviews.author: Matt Garibaldi
google_reviews.text:
Caring and professional. Made wonderful
suggestion that helped me in my state of overwhelm. Patient and empathetic staff. Top tier experience for memorial service, in my humble opinion.

google_reviews.author: Jess MacGlashin
google_reviews.text: In the shock of devastating grief, this funeral home knew exactly how to guide me through the painful logistics. They met me at my pace—pausing, repeating, and taking extra time when I couldn’t absorb information. They always answered the phone or returned calls quickly, which mattered so much in those moments.

google_reviews.author: Bartley Gerba
google_reviews.text: I have a lot of respect for people that Work at funeral homes. It is not easy losing people we love. And when you lose a child, it’s extra tough. Mindy from Miller Woodlawn Funeral Home Contacted me shortly after I reached out and left a message on their answering service. I informed her of my loss. She helped me through the process and understood what I wanted. Mindy Is a Professional and so is the team at Miller Woodlawn. Death is not easy to deal with but Miller Woodlawn funeral home is.

google_reviews.author: Pat Froslie
google_reviews.text:
My wife passed away and I didn't know where to call. I called Mills and Mills funeral home. Someone called me back, but I'm not sure who it was . Said the price was $900.00 for the cremation and $500.00 for transport of the body  . Mills and Mills said there prices were more and I just panicked, what was I going to do???
A young lady named Tiffany said " don't worry, we're going to take care of you " OMG , she was so kind and compassionate I felt like my wife was her sister. Mills and Mills and Tiffany went above and beyond. They made my experience bearable the tears I wanted to cry went away.
I believe in humanity again, there are good people out there. I would do anything for Tiffany after what she did for me and Trudi . I picked up her ashes this afternoon and I met Jeannie at the front desk, she was awesome also . Very friendly, made me smile and just put me at ease. My experience with Mills and Mills was great, I went in with tears but came out happy because of Tiffany.
If you need help with taking care of your loved ones , I highly......... let me say that again, I highly recommend Mills and Mills and Tiffany and all their staff . Losing my wife was devastating, Tiffany made it so much easier. I will never forget her.
Thank you so much
Patrick Froslie

google_reviews.author: sherry lynn
google_reviews.text:
If I can give 10, I would give them 10 out 10. Personally wanted to share my gratitude to Mills and Mills. I myself was so greatful for the help the gave us.  They were and are very compassionate. I lost my 21 year old daughter unexpectedly. Gennie there secretary was who we met comming in the door was amazing. Jamie the Director who help us through our process of getting what we needed went above and beyound.  Every thing we bought was perfect.
He did not sell us anything we didn't need or want and helped us pin point down what we needed and wanted for our daughter. I wanted to say to them all. Thank you sooo much it meant so much to us how they helped our process go smoothly and peacefully.
Thank you
Sherry Johnson

I highly recommend this company in Tummwater Wa.

google_reviews.author: Eug
google_reviews.text: Mills and mills were wonderful in supporting us after the recent passing of our family member. They've actually helped us now with now over five of our family members so we have a lot of experience with them. They are always communicative, organized, professional every step of the way. I had to call them late at night on Christmas and they were immediately ready to help us. Amazing. Paul Turner is an excellent funeral director who coordinated everything for us.  Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Donna Morrow
google_reviews.text:
Tiffany is such an amazing person. 2019 she took care of my granddaughter and she went out of her way to help my family out. My granddaughter was beautiful. Now on Monday of 2026 Tiffany help
my best friend put his wife to rest. Once again Tiffany went above and beyond to help. I just want to let you know that I appreciate everything you do you have a very kind 💜. I will always go to you.

google_reviews.author: Linda Ward
google_reviews.text:
In 2018 I prepaid two cremation policy’s from Mills and Mills Funeral cemetery for my husband and myself.  On August 29, 2024 I prepaid our interment policy’s at Mills and Mills funeral cemetery in the Honor Guard niche location.  Both times I was impressed with the way I was treated and never once did I feel pressured to buy something I didn’t want or needed.  I would recommend Bonnie Noel to help you with such an emotional issue as the last resting place for a loved one or yourself.
January 24, 2025 Update:
I have been waiting since my husband’s funeral service on October 3,2024 to be notified of the completed engraving and installation of the niche grave marker.  I called today and spoke to Mya.  She informed me the engraving and installation of the grave marker was completed on December 12, 2024.  This news upset me because I was not notified like I had been told I would be when the engraving was completed so I could attend and bring my family to get closure and honor my husband.  This lack of follow up makes me sad! I feel let down !

name: Moles Farewell Tributes & Crematory - Bayview Chapel

google_reviews.author: Andrew Oatman
google_reviews.text: When my mom passed away, everyone at Moles Tributes and Crematory demonstrated, empathy, support and respect during a very difficult time. It began with Amy and Tony showing up with a white rose expressing their condolences. They treated my mom with such dignity and grace. When we met with Stephanie and shared that we had a limited time line to get my mom's ashes so that we could have a memorial service before my brother had to return home, she made things happen. She not only walked us through the process with compassion, she had everything done within 2 days. We were extremely grateful. I was surprised to receive a follow up check-in from Moles asking me how we were doing and offering resources. Moles Tributes and Crematory went above and beyond our expectations and made what was a very difficult time seem more manageable. I highly recommend their services.

google_reviews.author: maria thurston
google_reviews.text:
I am a social worker and a caregiver who can attest to the experience that one is never fully prepared for even an anticipated death.
I am extremely grateful to Moles Funeral Home for responding immediately to an unexpected-expected situation and taking the reins  to compassionately and smoothly lead us through to a culminating closure per our loved one's requests.
This exceptional team softened the difficult steps and helped us towards a beautiful experience even though it required a timeline and a ferry to an island.
I am so appreciative of the support.
Moles Funeral Home was a blessing for us.

google_reviews.author: mutant deviant
google_reviews.text:
I chose Moles to take care of my loved one's cremation service in October 2025. The service i received was disappointing and left me wishing i had chosen another company for the service.
The full cost for basic cremation service without any of the extras is around $5,000. Nearly $3,000 of this is to cover the pay for a few staff that work in the office.
I met with the director who was setting up the initial service. The date of death was incorrect the first few attempts to print paperwork and due to a "lack of coffee". At one point the director assured me that "we don't have any creepy lurches in the basement". To their credit, they said they like interject humor into the interaction. Sure, fair, but the timing and the subject of the humor made it very ill-received.
When I paid for services, their computers weren't working and the receipt they said they would send me er showed up. I had to go in and ask for it 6 weeks later.
I waited to hear from them. I was anxious to pick up the remains for the memorial. The weeks went by. I could've called but I wanted them to do their job that pays so well. I called after 5 weeks of not hearing...no voicemail. The office person fumbled around to make up excuses why they didn't call..they didn't have the right number, the voicemail didn't come through...it was clearly forgotten.
Months later I find out my loved one's social security payments were not stopped because Moles failed to notify social security which is something they are supposed to do.
It is upsetting to pay so much, especially in a monetarily tight time of overwhelming grief, and be met with blunder after blunder.

google_reviews.author: Bill Przylucki
google_reviews.text: They were very helpful, responsive, and gracious with us. Stephenie Garcia was respectful and caring and made the entire process as positive as it could be under the circumstances.

google_reviews.author: Shelli Beeecher-Seitzler
google_reviews.text:
Stephenie (and the other associates) made the process of stressful loss become less stressful in regards to making decisions for necessary arrangements to take place.
I feel I was not alone in the process and well supported throughout the burial of my parent.  Gratitude to their services provided with care and concern.

google_reviews.author: Melissa Felix
google_reviews.text: Moles has always been such a wonderful facility to work with. John Moles has represented and carried on the Moles family name with such integrity, professionalism, and dedication with care. You can count on him and his staff with providing the utmost respect of cultural values, kindness, compassion, patience, and going out of their way to make sure they take care of your loved one. Moles takes care of you like family when your heart is most tender. Thank you ♥️

google_reviews.author: RUTH DROULLARD
google_reviews.text: Such tender kindness and care from each member of the Moles’ team. Micah and Marcos helped make the transition process so very peaceful.

google_reviews.author: Cheryl T.
google_reviews.text: Moles Funeral Home went above and beyond for our family and tribe during an incredibly difficult time. Planning a funeral for my mom was an emotional and overwhelming experience, but their team provided so much care and support every step of the way. We are especially grateful that they honored a very important part of our culture by allowing our Lummi gravediggers to assist with the burial at their cemetery. This gesture meant the world to us, and we deeply appreciate their understanding and respect for our traditions. The staff at Moles were truly phenomenal, offering kindness and professionalism throughout the process. We are thankful for everything they did for us.

google_reviews.author: Nathan
google_reviews.text: Thank you Micah, Jenny and the entire Moles tribute team. My father’s funeral was well planned and orchestrated with the utmost of respect& care. They made sure everything was setup and I didn’t have to worry about anything.

google_reviews.author: Armin Saba
google_reviews.text: John Moles and his staff at Moles Farewell Tributes went above and beyond my expectations during a very difficult time. They worked extremely hard to have all our needs met and ensured that the ceremony proceeded without a single flaw. name: Moles Farewell Tributes & Crematory - Greenacres Memorial Park

google_reviews.author: Michael Scott
google_reviews.text: They were very kind and helpful during this difficult time in our lives.  They also followed up with some great information on how to navigate the process of getting all the legal stuff squared away. Things like converting utilities accounts and such.  Would highly recommend.

google_reviews.author: Andrea Aguinaga
google_reviews.text: Moles Farewell Tributes & Crematory has truly made this very challenging time much easier for me and my family. Julia, John, Marcos, Steph, Caitlin and everyone else I have talked with met me with compassion and guidance. Every person has gone above and beyond for me and my family. I am deeply appreciative of Moles and everyone involved.

google_reviews.author: Kristi Baklund
google_reviews.text: The staff at Moles was friendly and professional.  Our initial meeting was informative and thorough.  Our Mom had prepaid for a package in advance, so the planning on our end was minimal.  The only upgrade we made was choosing a beautiful marble urn that we all loved and felt Mom would have  too.  Our only disappointment that we experienced was the timing of some services that were delayed a few days past the time that were quoted for the completion.  Overall, a good experience!

google_reviews.author: Quinn deKubber
google_reviews.text: My great grandparents were buried here in the mid aughts and I decided to pay them a visit recently. The grounds were well maintained, their headstone was clean, and the location felt very peaceful. I was having a hard time finding where they're buried so I went inside and asked a very helpful person sitting at the desk for directions, she took the time to find their exact location in the records and drew on a map how to find them. Would reccomend this as a final resting place for any loved one.

google_reviews.author: Mary Lou Childs
google_reviews.text: My identical twin sister didn't want her body to be cremated, and she didn't want to be buried in a casket, she wanted a "different" kind of burial. The "green burial" option at Moles was EXACTLY what she hoped to find!! An area at the back of their large Greenacres cemetery is called "The Meadow" and that is where people's bodies are allowed to be buried having been wrapped in a shroud only. So beautiful and natural!!! Our family and close friends opted to have an actual "burial" so we filled in sister's grave ourselves!!! It was super cool and so tender and loving!!! We decorated the top of her grave with 14 bird nests she collected over the years. Next, I will pick out a granite boulder to have our names engraved on, as one day my cremated remains will go in my twin sister's grave!! (One body and 3 cremated remains are allowed per grave.) I loved that option, too!!! And right now I am picking out "our" native tree, shrub, and ground cover that is included in the price of the plot. EVERY aspect of the burial, and these other things with the rock, tree, etc., have been  handled so professionally and with great care and attention to detail by the people at Moles. They have all been top notch. I could not be more pleased with their services.

google_reviews.author: L Hagen
google_reviews.text: Kerry Lee is a wonderful patient person to work with. My wife and I just finished our funeral preplan and it couldn't have been easier. 97% of the details have been planned saving our family the stress at our death. My parents did this with Mountain View over 30 years ago with Kerry. It made the process so simple at the time of their death. I recommend this to everyone. There are no surprises, they publish all their prices, so you don't have to worry about being high balled at a time of grief. Local cremation is what my wife wanted and they do that at their location. Very reasonable and your loved one stays local, no shipping them off to Spokane and waiting for the remains to be returned. They have a beautiful facility, friendly staff and local service. I highly recommend them. Larry Hagen

google_reviews.author: Stephen Bundi
google_reviews.text: I recommend this place 100%. David Bradley treated my wife and I with utmost respect and compassion when we needed to use their services. He did an excellent job in listening to us, understanding our need and offering us the best possible options that we could find. I feel we got the best price and service that we could have found anywhere in the Walla Walla area. David also coordinated well with the ministers we had chosen and directed a beautiful service for our little one. We didn't have much time to build memories with our baby but my wife and I are very grateful that Mountain View- Colonial Dewitt helped us capture something that will forever be a wonderful memory for us of the baby we never had time to share our lives with. I'm sure David and his team can do the same for you and totally recommend them. Thank you once again David and many many blessings on you and your team for the great job you do for this community.

google_reviews.text:
I am truly touched by how David and Samantha went above and beyond to help us plan my moms viewing and a meaningful graveside service. He was also so kind to walk my family and I through the steps of planning everything and Samantha helped make such a beautiful slideshow, which really honored my mom in such a meaningful way. Everything from the beautiful arrangement of flowers, sentimental slideshow, inviting atmosphere, and the care my mom received before we said goodbye, was done with grace, beauty and dignity.
I am so grateful for the kindness and care we received. I highly recommend this lovely couple, and team at Mountain View, to help take the utmost care of your loved one as you say goodbye.

google_reviews.author: Mason Dean
google_reviews.text: My mom passed away in July; we had her cremated through this company. Annette Drennen was the person who handled my mom’s paperwork and communicated with us. She messed up the paperwork multiple times. She would make mistakes and then send us a reminder to get it done, even though we couldn’t sign a piece of paper that was incorrect. This is a very serious and sad time. Professionalism is more than expected from people working in this line of work. We sent her every correction possible, and she still found ways to do this task incorrectly. It got to the point where the woman at the front desk went through every document with me, and we worked together to make sure it was right. They didn’t call the state like they were supposed to. They also failed to inform us that my mom had personal belongings on her when we went to split the ashes up at a different company; that is when we found out about the items. They lack professionalism, compassion, and integrity. Overall, I am not happy with this company, and I could not recommend this company any less.

google_reviews.author: Griselda Gutierrrez
google_reviews.text: we had a horrible experience with this funeral home. my brother who paid for my mom services called to see when he could pick up my mother death certificates many times on 1/10/2020 they told him they where not ready, then he asked well can i go pick them up next week Monday they said yes. when he went to pick up the certificates the following week, he was told they had already given the certificates to someone else, they didn't make sure that person was a family member, nor did they ask for ID or to sign anything. he was basically told Sorry if you want more you would have to pay again really. so basically anyone can walk into this funeral home and get death certificates from anyone that has just passed away all they have to do is say they are retaliated and they will be given the certificates. if you can go with another funeral home please do so. very unhappy with this funeral home . google_reviews.author: Amy G
google_reviews.text: Our family suffered a sudden tragic death.  Everyone at this establishment was kind and understanding.    Death is hard to handle.    We appreciate all the compassion we were shown.

google_reviews.author: M I
google_reviews.text:
Overall, the services provided by Neptune Society were okay, but there were several significant issues that made an already difficult time much more stressful.

The timeline for my dad’s cremation was delayed beyond what we were initially told, and I was unable to reach anyone directly for several days (close to a week). I repeatedly left messages through their third-party answering service without receiving a timely response.

The most concerning issue involved the paperwork required to transport my dad’s ashes internationally. Neptune Society was aware that I had a scheduled flight and that I needed the proper documentation to take his ashes out of the country. I was told they would handle the necessary paperwork. However, at the last minute, I was informed they were unable to obtain the final required document and was given contact information for the wrong consulate (Los Angeles instead of San Francisco).

When I contacted the correct consulate, I was told the required documents must be submitted at least two weeks in advance. Additionally, the consulate was located in a different state, so driving there in person was not an option. Because of this, I was unable to bring my dad with me on my scheduled flight. I do not travel to that part of the world often, so this was extremely upsetting.

While some aspects of the service were handled adequately, communication and coordination — especially regarding time-sensitive international documentation — should have been managed much more carefully.

google_reviews.author: Carolyn Todd
google_reviews.text: Neptune delivered. Everything in one simple straight forward plan. It doesn’t look like there will be much at all my children will be responsible for at all. Then there was Anthony. Charming, sweet, clever,  friendly  sales person. He was professional when needed but reacted to a good joke. Two elderly crazy sisters who never stop talking would be a strain on anyone but Anthony was great. I’m so glad finally got this decided and co-ordinated to save stress on my children when the time comes. I plan on living till 110, but surprises happen.

google_reviews.author: Ann Tozier

Not only did they make everything clear to us, in a sensitive way, but they were also unbelievably responsive anytime we had questions.  It is a difficult time for families, and they made it work so smoothly for us.  Thank you!!

google_reviews.author: Carol Richards

And as a result everything was quick and easy when thinking and making plans would have been almost impossible. And they followed up to comfort and help us afterwards too. More than we expected by far.

google_reviews.author: Melanie Witsman

google_reviews.author: Kimberlie Witters

google_reviews.author: Linsey Aulisio Reid
google_reviews.text: The Neptune Society was incredibly kind and compassionate during one of the hardest times of our lives. I’m truly grateful for the care they provided and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a compassionate team during such difficult moments.

google_reviews.author: Sandra Solomon

I would also give a thank you to Elizabeth for checking in after everything took place and make sure we knew about the free services they offer for grieving families. A 10 star from me. He went above and beyond to make sure everything that needed to happen got done. Thank you Keith for helping me get through this

My dad sadly passed away which was one of the hardest things I have had to deal with in life. I had known that my parents set up arrangements years ago with Neptune Society. They had said many times over the years "now when we pass away all you have to do is call this number and they will handle everything" my thought was YEAH YEAH YEAH, thats never gonna happen...well it did 😢 I called that number and talked to the most professional compassionate nicest person on one of the worst days of my life. google_reviews.text: I choose Neptune years ago because of a prior experience.  They have always been professional, helpful and caring.  I feel your love ones should be treated with the utmost respect and dignity during this extremely hard and traumatic situation.  Every person I have dealt with there has been wonderful.  I highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: Ruth Kennon
google_reviews.text: When my elderly parents passed away two years apart, our family was so grateful that they had made their funeral arrangements with Neptune Society many years ago.  We were not burdened with the expense or having to make funeral arrangements while grieving.  Recently my husband and I made our funeral arrangements with the Neptune Society in Tacoma.  Eamonn Anderson, the Pre-Arrangement Advisor did a wonderful job explaining our options and the pricing.  There was no sales pressure and the whole process took about an hour and a half.  We are very relieved now that our family will not be burdened with having to make our arrangements.

google_reviews.author: Larry Larsen
google_reviews.text:
Probably one of the best purchases my wife and I ever made. We purchased our plan well over 20 years ago,  not expecting to use it for another 20.
My wife passed away suddenly and we called Neptune to get the process in motion.
The crew responded within an hour or so.
I had to leave the room while they collected her body. I had to leave the room while they were doing their thing.
There is no way I could have stayed to watch.
It took a little over a week for her to be ready. I went with a friend to collect her.
Throughout the process it was respectful and dignified. I dont know how I would have handled it without Neptune.
As an aside, I wanted an urn that fit her personality rather than the black box. Amazon sells urns that are artful and appropriate.

google_reviews.author: Kelley McDowall Pearce

Jennifer walked us through every option, gave us guidance when we didn’t know what to do and did an amazing job helping with the celebration of life. She gets 5+ stars⭐️

His carelessness reopened my wounds, disrespected my husband’s memory and made it feel like it was just another body he was emailing a family about. I assure you he wasn’t. I hope Brian’s family never has to feel the way that email made me feel. He also sent it to my daughter which was uncalled for.  His rating ⚫️

google_reviews.text: Tammy was kind and compassionate throughout the entire experience. I highly recommend working with her through the challenging time of losing a loved one.

google_reviews.author: Ted Lingbloom
google_reviews.text: We were from out of town/state when our daughter passed. We used PNWC&F for our cremation needs and were so pleased and impressed with the kind, genuine compassion, and professional care we received from Tami. There were many aspects of our unusual circumstances, and everything was addressed, handled, and taken care of with utmost care and professionalism. We never met with her/anyone personally, but she walked me through all aspects of the what's, how's, & needs of the process &  everything was done over the phone and email. She was our angel. We highly recommend this company for your needs in an already intense situation in the death of a loved one! They truly handled us with care and compassion and in a timely manner.

google_reviews.author: John Raikes
google_reviews.text: Tammy is a very professional and sweet representative with Pacific NW Cremation and Funeral.  She was totally honest and caring throughout the process of meeting my specific needs regarding my bride of 47 years.  Never once did she loose focus nor did she try to up-price services or try to offer services I did not want or need.   Thank you for the wonderful experience during our time of grief.

google_reviews.author: Teresa Atchison
google_reviews.text: From the moment I called Pacific NW cremation after my mom passed away, Tammy treated me with such incredible kindness and compassion, I will never forget it. She was very personable, extremely competent and kept me informed every step of the way. They took impeccable care of my mom as well, which was very important to me, and I appreciated their tenderness at such a difficult time. I would highly recommend Pacific NW Cremation to anyone who may need their services.

google_reviews.author: Jeff Murphy
google_reviews.text: Very pleased with the caring services provided to manage my wife's funeral arrangements. Information for planning was very accessible, the staff was efficient and caring, and they offered a wide variety of options to fill anyone's needs. I would highly recommend Pacific NW Cremation & Funeral for managing your final destination needs.

google_reviews.author: Shauna Connelly
google_reviews.text: In September 2025 we got the call we'd dreaded, my younger brother was found deceased,  he had completed suicide. He was homeless at the time of his death. But Jason treated us with care and respect  , and we won't ever forget that! The compassion shown from the first call to pacific NW Cremation,  was so welcomed especially shown to my mother, who begged Jason to fix her boy 💔.  The cost was so much more affordable than our local funeral home. We are truly thankful for the referral from a friend for Pacific NW Cremation

google_reviews.author: Amber Morelli (BabyGirl)
google_reviews.text:
October 2024 Our family turned to PNWC for the suddenly tragic death of my 28yro Son. During the most unbearably traumatic time we as a family have ever gone through together, everyone at PNWC were so helpful and kind but above all they were patient and understanding with all of us. My son has a big mix of biological and extended family as well as honorary family and I'm sure having so many people to talk with can be difficult. We mainly worked with Elizabeth who treated us all with respect, she listened to all of our needs and helped us navigate through all of the decisions and details we needed to get through for the funeral service, burial and celebration of Life. We couldn't have gotten through it without Elizabeth, she assisted us every step of the way.
It takes very special people to do what they do and I am so thankful for everything PNWC did in helping us to make my son's funeral so special. Thank you PNWC so very much for everything you do.

google_reviews.author: Beth Romig
google_reviews.text: During a most difficult time, everyone here made the experience pleasant.  Starting with the front desk, she was kind, respectful and very helpful.  The Funeral Director and all staff were also very helpful, respectful and kind.  Everything we ordered from the catalog was beautiful, with one of the small urns really gorgeous.  I would highly recommend their services.

google_reviews.author: Michelle “Shelli” Meyer Ketchum
google_reviews.text:
My family and I are extremely grateful for the genuine and kind employees who worked with us after the sudden death of my mom. Jenny was our initial contact due to my mom passing in Spokane, she helped my family choose a plan that both honored my mother's memory as well as our family's budget.
Jenny was very knowledgeable, patient, kind, and a truly dedicated, caring professional during this difficult time. Thank you!
Ryan Rasmussen is the funeral director we met with at their Coeur d'Alene office. Ryan was a breath fresh air, very authentic, and much appreciated when it came to assisting us with selecting our cremains necklaces.
My young granddaughters accompanied my daughter and I when we met with Ryan at the CdA office. My daughter and I were both impressed with the genuine concern and kindness he showed towards my granddaughters; the girls were soon visiting with Ryan in the comfortable front space, allowing my daughter and I the time to explain the myriad selection of cremains jewelry to one of our family members who couldn't be there in person-thank you Ryan for giving us this opportunity and making us feel like we were welcomed and understood-you are a true gem and just an awesome human being!
I would whole heartedly recommend Pacific NW Cremation to anyone experiencing the loss of a loved one, my family and I have a beautiful custom made urn, keepsake cremains jewelry that we will treasure forever and most importantly, some much needed peace of mind knowing mom's life celebration can begin!

google_reviews.author: Lori Duncan
google_reviews.text: The staff at Pacific Northwest Cremation were all very kind and empathetic with regards my husband's passing. They were very supportive and we weren't rushed in making our decisions regarding what his final wishes were.

google_reviews.author: Juliette D
google_reviews.text:
Penttilas Chapel by the Sea made a very difficult period in my life a little bit easier when my husband suddenly passed.

They were present, caring, respectful and informative every step of the way from my husband’s initial intake all the way through carrying out his final wishes. I mention that they were informative because it is during those vulnerable moments when you’re not thinking straight and next steps are difficult to come by on your own. Not once did I feel like I was being taken advantage of — they were impeccable in their integrity and level of care for my husband.

I highly recommend their services.

google_reviews.author: Sydney Stevens
google_reviews.text:
Kind.  Informative.  Helpful.
These are the words that immediately come to mind when I'm asked about the staff and services  at Penttila's Chapel by the Sea. Eric and Melissa eased me through a confusing and difficult time, making the requirements by government agencies and other institutions more understandable and giving me much-needed confidence along the way.  Most of all, though they had never before met me or Nyel, they treated us both with dignity and respect.  I can't thank them enough for helping me through an otherwise unbearable time.
Sydney Stevens

google_reviews.author: T Q
google_reviews.text:
Jake greeted all of us right when we walked, he was very informative with a quiet demeanor. My mother looked as if she was laying there sleeping, her color was there, she was covered with a nice purple colored blanket. (Purple being her favorite color/quincident or not) I thought that made it even better, considering..... We had two other rooms we could sit down and talk with him answering any and all questions; or another room to sit and just get up the courage to see her beautiful face one last time with our own two eyes. I am very pleased with the communication between Jake and my family. Notifying us step by step and reassuring us everything we asked to be done; he said he would do for sure. Thank you Penttila's Chapel by the Sea. You have made a very hard time; an undeniably almost unbearable time; just a tiny bit better, so I thank you once again.
Sincerely,
Tabatha Quashnick (& family)

google_reviews.author: Theresa Mancini
google_reviews.text: Penttila's laid both my mother and recently my father to rest, 5 years apart. All I can say is everyone we worked with was kind, compassionate and honest. They patiently answered all of our questions and made a heartbreaking task bearable - for which I am eternally grateful.

google_reviews.author: Michael RR
google_reviews.text: My Family has deep roots in the Peninsula. My Great Grandma and Grandpa and my Great Great Grandma and Grandpa are Resting in Peace in Ilwaco Cemetery. Ron and Mariya were such a delight to work with to help me and my Father find Family Gravesites. I just wanted to right a Quick Thanks a Million for your Help. Wonderful Folks!!

google_reviews.author: Алёша
google_reviews.text:
Recently, our family experienced a great loss — our father passed away. We did not want him to be cremated and instead decided to send his body home to Belarus. We called several funeral homes, but none of them had experience with international repatriation to our country — and no one could guarantee it was even possible.

Calvin was the exception. He impressed us with both his professionalism and his compassion. He not only gave us hope but immediately took on this challenging task. There were many bureaucratic hurdles along the way, but Calvin was always quick to respond, contacted embassies, resolved issues, and stayed in touch even late at night. He supported us every step of the way, went above and beyond, and never let us lose hope.

We chose Personal Alternatives and never once regretted it. People and professionals like Calvin are rare. We are deeply grateful to Calvin and his team.

google_reviews.author: Cristina Miller
google_reviews.text:
TLDR/ Price: Reasonable, Service: Exemplary, Verdict: Worthwhile Option

Losing a loved one is the most difficult time in a persons life. My husband recently lost his mother after a long battle with health issues. She was left with very little money and so we had to cover the costs associated with her death. We searched for the most reasonably priced option around our area and asked for recommendations from friends and family. Personal Alternative was both recommended to us by two different family members and came up online as a reasonably priced option. A higher cost funeral home actually recommended them to us as well.

The staff made the process easy, walking us through the steps and options with regards to cremation, and how my mother-in-law’s remains would be taken care of. Even picking up her urn and signing the final paperwork was a relatively simple process that was made much more bearable by the competency and consideration of the staff on site.

Don’t believe the negative reviews, they seem to have been written from a place of deep grief, and do not seem to reflect the true nature of this business. If you decide to go with Personal Alternative, they are a good option for when cost is a factor and even when it isn’t, the caring staff and expedient process can make a hard time a little less hard.

google_reviews.author: Debbie Whitaker
google_reviews.text:
A letter I sent to the Personal Alternative Funeral Services handling my Dads final wishes.....PLEASE read & share! DO NOT do business with this company!

To whom it may concern,
My father passed away last month and had a policy/plan with your company. I have been dealing with Melissa, at the Kent office. It has honestly been a nightmare. She has caused so much more unneeded stress to an already very difficult time. I have had to contact her not less than 8 times, and am still waiting on responses, not to mention the death certificates that I specifically asked her to send to my home in Arizona, so I could handle some of my Dad's final business while I'm back at home. I have still not received them. Now I am flying back to Washington in a week to take care of his estate, and I have no idea where the death certificates are. Either still en-route or sent to my Dad's house, I have no idea. So once again I have to contact her. (UPDATE……turns out she gave them to my nephew with the ashes, instead of mailing to me as requested and agreed upon…..more incompetence!) The last time we spoke in person she was extremely rude and condescending. When I called her on it and asked to please speak to someone else, she told me there was no one else and I had to speak to her. She continued talking to me as if I were a 2 year old. I am also still awaiting an answer to a question I asked about several times. That is if my dad had a spot at Evergreen Washelli for his ashes. He told me he did, and I cannot find any info on it. Melissa said she would find out for me and let me know. Still nothing. I will never recommend this company to anyone. Unbelievable customer service you offer for the grieving.
Sincerely,
Debbie A. W.

google_reviews.author: Nat Latos
google_reviews.text: Dealing with death is never easy. Like many people I was pretty frayed emotionally when I walked into their office. Calvin sat down and took some time to talk with me and really help me in a difficult time. The considerate treatment I received through the whole process was invaluable. I highly recommend their services.

google_reviews.author: Rajanae Williams
google_reviews.text: I want to say this review is strictly on customer service. A lady that works there is really rude unless it’s her personality? And if it’s her personality it truly sucks. How can you be so insulting and be unpleasant when all I am trying to do is ask you a question. And I gave Sasha the benefit of the doubt a couple of times but she is really nasty. I really hope you guys give her more training because the way she comes off to those grieving about their loved ones is just sad no one should have to encounter someone like her.

google_reviews.author: Alex Pembrook
google_reviews.text: Came in at the beginning of January to make arrangements to cremate my mother, and after talking with Justin, I felt much better working with this funeral home. He explained the process and what they would do for me regarding a small service. He even offered his services as an ordained minister to perform her funeral for free. I couldn't believe it. I went to the funeral home downtown in Moses Lake, and they were way out of my price range and wanted all the money up front, or they wouldn't do anything. Justin said they offered a payment plan with a small down payment. I put down $200, and he took care of everything. Every week I'm in there, and he takes really good care of our family. I only paid $1900, and the other funeral home wanted $3600 in advance. Everyone needs to go to Pioneer Memorial Services for all their funeral needs. They really care about families.

google_reviews.author: Mike Thomas
google_reviews.text: This past weekend, my cousin William passed away. Unfortunately, I wasn't there, but I heard how Justin, the guy who picked up my cousin from his home, was more than kind. William's daughter was at work when this happened, and a co-worker brought her home, leaving her car there. When all the paperwork was done, Justin asked her if she needed a ride back to her car. On the way back to the funeral home with William, he dropped off Cassy at her car. He didn't have to do that. In fact, he could have told her it was against company policy, but he didn't. He offered her the ride. She didn't ask. What company does that? This is mind-blowing to me. When Cassy asked how much this would cost, he explained the cost but offered to accept payments. He knew that, with her working at a Rest Home, she didn't have much money in the bank. I know William didn't. Cassy, if you're reading this, count yourself lucky. This was very kind.

google_reviews.author: Winfred Forrest
google_reviews.text: This past week, a friend of mine went in to make arrangements for his Grandmother, and he said the Funeral Director he worked with, Justin Morris, was excellent. He said that when Justin called him, he noticed how Justin said that he had his Grandma in his care. The word "care" was the magic word for us. To them, his Grandma wasn't just another body in their fridge; she was a person that they were caring for. We really appreciate that Pioneer Memorial takes great pride in how they deal with their families. Justin is a light when people are at their darkest. Could you make sure he sticks around?

google_reviews.author: J Stairs Stairs

The difficulty of  making funeral arrangements for a loved one is physically and mentally exhausting.  We were thankful for Powers Funeral Home helping us navigate through this process. google_reviews.author: Monica Britt

Thank you Powers for your care of me!

google_reviews.author: Pam Tradup
google_reviews.text: We appreciated the attentiveness and care during a difficult time for our family. Mike was knowledgeable and constantly available for our questions, last minute changes or anything we needed. His calm demeanor was just what we needed.

google_reviews.author: Jennifer “Jenn” Hufty
google_reviews.text:
I want to extend my deepest gratitude to Precht Rose Funeral Home, and especially to Mike Boyd, for the incredible compassion and support shown to my family during one of the most difficult times in our lives. Mike didn’t just handle the arrangements for my beloved grandmother who recently passed—he also cared for our family back in 2017 when we lost my grandfather.

Mike’s kindness goes far beyond professionalism. He treated my grandma with such fondness and respect, and it was clear she held a special place in his heart too. From the first call to the final details, Mike was patient, gentle, and truly present with us—never rushing, always listening. He made us feel like we weren’t alone, like we had a steady hand and a caring friend walking beside us through the process.

There is something deeply comforting about having someone who not only knows their job but cares deeply about the people they serve. Mike made sure every detail honored my grandma’s memory beautifully, and our whole family felt the love and grace he poured into his work.

If you’re looking for a funeral home that leads with heart, integrity, and personal connection, I cannot recommend Precht Rose—and Mike Boyd—highly enough. In times of loss, they are truly a blessing🙏

google_reviews.author: William L. Wolcott
google_reviews.text: A five star rating is insufficient to convey the level of kindness, caring, and compassion shown by Mike Boyd and others at Barnes Chapel during a very difficult time. google_reviews.author: Jeff Field

google_reviews.author: Tracey Reagles
google_reviews.text:
I have lost my mom, dad and brother in the last 3 years. What a difficult season of life, but Mike Boyd made each of these losses so much easier. His knowledge and experience, easy, calming, and peaceful spirit, go a long way in comforting broken hearts.
My most recent loss, my dad, came just a couple of weeks ago. Mike and his new assistant, Knute came to my home to pick up my dad after his death. I can't express my gratitude enough about the respectful, compassionate kindness my family was shown by these two men.
Mike goes above and beyond. So many personal details,  that he handles gracefully.

google_reviews.author: Tonya Bradshaw

google_reviews.author: Nancy Koop
google_reviews.text:

They were gentle and respectful and went the extra step of getting her fingerprints (per our request) for us so we could have jewelry made with them. I believe my mother would have liked them too. Thank you so much for making my worst moments more bearable.
Nancy

google_reviews.author: Anna
google_reviews.text: We didn't end up going with this service due to location reasons, but they were so compassionate and great to talk to over the phone. They quickly responded and gave concise estimates, which sounded pretty reasonable cost wise. It's clear that they truly care about people!

google_reviews.author: Howard hagedorn
google_reviews.text: The most compassionate and caring staff one could ever hope to find during an unpleasant time.  These amazing people helped me and my family through this and have earned my respect and appreciation for all they did.

google_reviews.author: Angie Morgan-Chilmonik
google_reviews.text: Recently had to call a few times and ask some questions.  Phone was answered every time and Pat & Glenn were super helpful and accommodating!

google_reviews.author: Tisha Ruffin
google_reviews.text: Our family had an unfortunate death in our family and had to make a quick decision on where our loved one would go. I'm happy we chose Price Helton. google_reviews.author: Jean Elliott
google_reviews.text:

google_reviews.author: Yvonne Matheson

They were very respectful when they came to pick up Phil.  They let us say goodbye didn't rush us let us take our time. Tracy in the office was a doll she helped me so much just adore her.

google_reviews.author: Julie Towne
google_reviews.text: As caretaker to a family member in hospice, I didn't have time for a face-to-face meeting to make burial arrangements before his passing. These two young people were incredibly thoughtful, respectful, professional and kind! We chose cremation and were able to bring Dad back home very quickly. This was a very positive experience during a very trying time. Thank-you Price-Helton!

google_reviews.author: edward h
google_reviews.text: From start to finish during the difficult process of saying goodbye to our mother, the entire staff treated us with care and handled everything we needed to be done. Truly blessed to have had them work with us. Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Linda Killough

google_reviews.author: Pam Senter
google_reviews.text: Thanks to The wonderful staff at Purdy and Kerr funeral home in Monroe, we were able to have a wonderful memorial service for our beloved Son. google_reviews.author: Thea G
google_reviews.text: Purdy and Kerr were kind and compassionate with us during the loss of our mother. We are so grateful for Anne Jenny’s celebrant service - she tuned right into our mother’s legacy. Thank you for being there during this time.

google_reviews.author: janis george
google_reviews.text: Purdy and Kerr staff were incredibly compassionate, kind, and helpful. My dad passed away suddenly, and we were nowhere near prepared for this. Everyone was amazing and guided us through the process of preparing a service for my dad. I cannot say enough, how much my sisters and I appreciated all their help. google_reviews.author: laureen carlson
google_reviews.text: The lady we had was very nice, never tried to push anything but what we wanted. Explained everything in terms we understood.

google_reviews.author: susan rushing
google_reviews.text: My mom passed 11/24 and I chose Purdy and Kerr.  From the second I spoke to Terry he put me and other family members at ease.  He took care of every single detail no matter how small.  The beautiful job they did with the wake and ensuing service was amazing.  No matter the details, they thought of, making sure the experience was reverent showing deep honor and respectfulness to mom , family, and friends.  The day of burial my mothers casket was draped with our nations flag having remembered to transport all flowers displayed at service.  Two members of Purdy and Kerr accompanied my mom all the way to Tahoma National cemetery.  Once there they displayed such respect and attention to every single detail we simply had no worry only words of admiration and gratitude.  When my father passed in 2014 another funeral home was selected in Totem Lake.  The difference to detail was night and day.  If you are seeking a funeral home that you wish to divest yourself of worry or stress I would recommend Purdy in Kerr located in Monroe, Wa.  The service at that chapel was spectacular, I know my mother would have been so proud of us for the celebration of her life.

name: Purdy & Walters with Cassidy Funeral Home

google_reviews.author: Janice Richardson
google_reviews.text: Today my friends mother had her service here.  The staff was amazing. They catered  to the guests needs and with a smile and kindness.  We used a lot of hot water for tea and coffee.  Staff was professional, kind, prompt and thoughtful.  Strongly recommend.

google_reviews.author: Theresa Jingco
google_reviews.text: I’m grateful for the team at Solie. Our funeral director was Natalie - she was so kind and made this difficult process stress free for my family. Everyone from Solie who we came in contact with was professional, respectful and empathetic. I cannot thank them enough for helping us get through this time - Thank you so much!

google_reviews.author: Jenta Hing
google_reviews.text:
Natalie and the entire team at Solie Funeral Home went far beyond anything I could have expected. From start to finish, their compassion, professionalism, and genuine care made all the difference during one of the most difficult times in our lives.

Natalie’s kindness and sincerity shined through every step of the process. She wasn’t just there to help—she was truly present with us. She laughed,  cried, and helped guide us through a moment we never thought we could handle. She was always available, never pushy, and made sure everything was done exactly how we wanted to honor our mom.

Choosing Solie was one of the best decisions we made. Thank you, Natalie and Team, from the bottom of my heart and on behalf of my entire family.

google_reviews.author: Caitlyn S
google_reviews.text: My family’s experience with Solie was excellent. We worked mostly with Jon who was very patient, compassionate and professional. Everyone else we encountered here was respectful and kind as well. Thank you so much to everyone here for creating a seamless and smooth experience during such a hard time. You are appreciated.

google_reviews.author: Sarakvitou Sam
google_reviews.text:
Solie have been great and helpful throughout the entire process during our hard time. A sudden loss of my stepfather had my family and I overwhelmed emotionally, which made it hard to begin to think of what to do next.

My family and I had never had any prior experience with funerals before in the US. Although my family knew the set of Cambodian traditions to perform after the death of a loved one, they still did not know how many Cambodian traditions could be carried out in the US and how many in a funeral home. Regardless, my family wanted at the very least, monk services (reciting scripts/sermons) to be performed for him at the funeral day throughout the event, and right before his cremation took place. So, I called up a few places on the pamphlet that Providence had given me to see if any of the funeral homes on the list could accommodate our requirements. When I made my initial call to Solie, they were very understanding of the situation, and had told me that they had provided services for Cambodian families before. What had stood out to me the most is their ability to provide details about their services and to articulate the description of Cambodian services done by those clients. With the information they gave me from the phone call, my family was able to decide exactly what needed to be done and what expectations to have.

Solie was also quite responsive with their communication (email, and phone call) and was able to work quickly with our requirements. My family wanted to hold the funeral for my stepfather within the first week of his passing, preferably before the 7th day from the day he passed (traditional reason). Only a couple of hours after I made the call to Providence to inform the funeral home choice, I received a call from Solie that my stepfather had been taken into their care. Fast forward to the days of services, every staff was very helpful with any requests we had made.

This might be too small of a detail but I would like to mention this because I think someone might find it useful. It might have escaped my mind to think of the next steps would be after the funeral services were done. But Paul was very attentive and had asked if we had already considered a place to keep my stepfather (whether it is a mausoleum or something else). So, we were quick to choose a cemetery and explore different placement options, which helped us placing my stepfather in time soon after the services were done.

Bottom line is I strongly recommend Solie for any families who seek a helpful, diligent, and wonderful funeral home for their loved one.

google_reviews.author: rico rico
google_reviews.text: While I wasn't exactly jumping for joy at the idea of myself no longer existing, the composting appeals to my values and I am so glad I toured Recompose. PLEASE NOTE: that is NOT a body in the first photo, but a depiction of how a body is wrapped for ceremonial purposes, etc.

google_reviews.author: Leif Utne
google_reviews.text: Great tour of a great company. I've been aware of Recompose for a few years, but was thrilled to finally get to see their operation in person. Human composting is a great concept -- saving a metric ton of CO2 vs. cremation, and saving the land taken up by a burial plot. And Recompose executes this idea beautifully. The lovingly designed facility has a minimalist, eco-chic aesthetic that feels, as someone else on our tour put it, "like a spa for the dead." When I die, don't just compost me. Take me to Recompose, please.

google_reviews.author: Angie Ward
google_reviews.text: Washington State is so fortunate to have Natural Organic Reduction (human body composting) as an alternative option to conventional cemetery burial and cremation.
