You can sign up on their website.👍😀

google_reviews.author: Sara Hartzell
google_reviews.text:
I can’t describe how wonderful it was to find Return Home after my husband died unexpectedly in February. He and I had not done any preplanning and I didn’t even know an option like this existed in Nebraska. Return Home took responsibility for transporting my husband to their facility in Auburn WA, including working with the initial conventional funeral home that collected him from the hospital but was not able to provided the services I was hoping for.
It was important to me that my husband re-entered the cycle of life as completely and as unaltered as possible. I did not want his cells soaked in chemicals and locked away in a vault. Nor did I want every last bit of life in him burned to ash. I wanted him to return to the earth and have all of his molecules and energy remain a part of life. I wanted all of the bacteria and fungi that were part of his body to be able to continue on. I wanted his body to nourish future life. I know many people are able to have their loved ones continue on through the gift of organ donation. Because of the way my husband died this was not an option for me. But Return Home offered that opportunity through an alternative avenue. and I am forever grateful.
Coincidentally, my daughter lives about 30 miles from Auburn so we were able to visit. It is a warm and comforting space that does not feel at all like a funeral home. They brought his vault down so that we could spend some time with him. They answered all of our questions and shared a bit of the history behind the service. I have to say my daughter, son-in-law, and I were so pleased withe place, kindness, and philosophy of the service that we all intend to make this our final plan as well. I have shared the story with other friends and family members and many were excited to know this option existed.
I will soon be able to take my husband home and decide what to do with his remains so that we can return him to the places he loved and also keep a part of him with each of us.
Again, I am so grateful to have found Return Home and hope that more and more people will consider this as a meaningful and holistic option to conventional burial or cremation.

google_reviews.author: Kim Hann
google_reviews.text: When the time came to complete the final arrangements for my mom, Return Home was prompt, professional, respectful, and empathetic from start to finish. google_reviews.text:
My mom chose to be terracomposted, and Return Home, when we spoke about her future death in 2020. She originally thought about a plot in a cemetery, so I could visit. I asked her, "Did you visit your parents' graves, because I know where they are buried, and you didn't take me." She said, "No." I said, "I won't be visiting you either. It's not how I will honor you or remember you." But she liked the idea of being in my garden where her roses will grow and be loved all of us.

Return Home was easy to work with, and easy to book years in advance. A mandatory insurance is necessary, which RH facilitated.

After her death in late 2025, at 9:30PM on a Sunday, we made the call at 10PM from her Adult Family Home. Her remains were picked up at about 12:15 AM, along with a rose to be composted with her.

The office then communicated and asked questions, offered emotional support, sent a nice note and gift, and kept us informed of the process.  We chose to have this done without our input/placement of her body into the vessel, but know she's moving along the process with regular email updates.

RH has been the easy part of her death. Pleasant to deal with and professional. I am glad she chose to something less toxic and more natural way to die. We are choosing to take her soil--which isn't mandatory. I love she will be in my flower garden and at my sister's too.

What stood out most was how they went above and beyond to lighten our burden—handling details with respect and attention, while offering ongoing grief support resources. It's clear they see this as a privilege to serve families, and it shows in everything they do.
If you're in Whatcom County or the Bellingham area and need compassionate funeral services, Sig's is the place to trust. Thank you for making a heartbreaking process as supportive and dignified as possible.

google_reviews.author: Mel-Beth Haug
google_reviews.text: We have turned to Sig's Funeral & Cremation Services multiple times over the years — for both of my parents, my husband’s parents, and most recently my brother — and every single experience has been handled with the utmost care, compassion, and professionalism. Justin, Sig, Marva and Natalie have consistently gone above and beyond to make difficult times a little easier, guiding us through every detail with patience and understanding. The services were beautiful and respectful, and the entire team treated our family like their own. We are deeply grateful for their kindness, support, and the peace of mind they’ve given us each time. I recommend Sig's to everyone I know because I trust them completely and know they will provide the same kindness and respect to others.

google_reviews.author: Sandy Ekse
google_reviews.text: Unfortunately we have had to use the services of Sig’s funeral and cremation services 4 times in the last few years.  I cannot begin to explain how helpful and sensitive everyone at Sig’s has been in our darkest moments.  They went above and beyond to help make the process as simple as possible for us, always showing the utmost care and empathy for our situation.  Our family highly recommends their services.

google_reviews.author: Austin Wilkerson
google_reviews.text: I can’t thank the staff at Sigs enough for how phenomenal they were to my family & I. Being 30 and trying to plan a funeral for your Grandmother isn’t the easiest but the staff at Sigs made sure I understood all my options and answered every question I had. Justin was great at helping plan the service with guidance from what my Grandmother wanted and gave good insight on what other items may cost. Marva made sure the funeral programs were perfect and Sig was always checking in making sure we didn’t need anything else while there. They did a wonderful job making my Grandma look perfect for the viewing. They also assisted us in moving my Grandfather from one cemetery to another and made that process far simpler than it would have been with anyone else. Can’t thank the family enough for their compassion at such a difficult time!

google_reviews.author: Ann-Marie Olive
google_reviews.text: Sig's has handled funeral arrangements for members of my extended family and friends. In all cases, they have been so professional, very quick to respond to questions, and made sure that all arrangements were taken care of in a thoughtful and compassionate way. This is a family run funeral home and it shows. They go out of their way to treat those that are grieving with special care. Because of this, I have become very familiar with the funeral homes in our county and how they operate. There are only two funeral homes that I would recommend and Sig's is #1 of the two.

google_reviews.author: Tammy Caley
google_reviews.text: I am so thankful that I chose Smart Cremation for my cremation needs. My mother and I attended a seminar with Andrew and it was very informative. There was no pressure to purchase anything that day, although many people did. We came home and we both had a few more questions, so we met with Andrew again, two more times! Both times Andrew was patient and answered all of our questions. We both enjoyed the information and working with Andrew was awesome. Thank you Smart Cremation!

google_reviews.author: Steve Carney
google_reviews.text: I found Smart Cremation professional, helpful and a pleasure to deal with. We purchased our Smart Cremation many years ago. After the amount of time had passed, I wondered if it was still good. What I found out was all of the services were as excellent as the day we purchased them. I can't thank them enough.

google_reviews.author: Velvin Higby
google_reviews.text: Andrew was very helpful in answering our questions and providing information. The Smart Creation services offered through this plan simplify the death arrangements. This is a comfort to us and our family. Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Beverly Roach
google_reviews.text: Bill was great. He came to my house so my daughter could learn what Smart Cremation would be doing for me after my death. Basically there is nothing my family would need to do. This provided me with peace of mind. The cost of my plan was very reasonable for all the services Smart Cremation will perform. Bill was very knowledgeable and had my trust!!

google_reviews.author: sissy perkins
google_reviews.text: After a number of family members have passed away I have seen first hand, the difference between a planned cremation and unplanned.  When my parents passed away, I was relieved that this was one detail that I didn't have to contend with, given all the other tasks involved with one's passing.  I was looking for a company that I could make my plans with and as luck would have it, I received an invitation for a free seminar sponsored by Smart Cremation.  I was impressed that their plan includes travel, urn, a planning book for survivors to get vital information from and they even offer post-cremation support and guidance on issues like who to call for services and accounts (like Social Security).  And I REALLY appreciate there were several VERY manageable payment plans available. Andy, the Smart Creation Representative was kind, knowledgeable, and truly cares about clients and the company he works for.  This was a great experience.   Thank you!

google_reviews.author: Janice Richardson
google_reviews.text: Today my friends mother had her service here.  The staff was amazing. They catered  to the guests needs and with a smile and kindness.  We used a lot of hot water for tea and coffee.  Staff was professional, kind, prompt and thoughtful.  Strongly recommend.

google_reviews.author: Theresa Jingco
google_reviews.text: I’m grateful for the team at Solie. Our funeral director was Natalie - she was so kind and made this difficult process stress free for my family. Everyone from Solie who we came in contact with was professional, respectful and empathetic. I cannot thank them enough for helping us get through this time - Thank you so much!

google_reviews.author: Jenta Hing
google_reviews.text:
Natalie and the entire team at Solie Funeral Home went far beyond anything I could have expected. From start to finish, their compassion, professionalism, and genuine care made all the difference during one of the most difficult times in our lives.

Natalie’s kindness and sincerity shined through every step of the process. She wasn’t just there to help—she was truly present with us. She laughed,  cried, and helped guide us through a moment we never thought we could handle. She was always available, never pushy, and made sure everything was done exactly how we wanted to honor our mom.

Choosing Solie was one of the best decisions we made. Thank you, Natalie and Team, from the bottom of my heart and on behalf of my entire family.

google_reviews.author: Caitlyn S
google_reviews.text: My family’s experience with Solie was excellent. We worked mostly with Jon who was very patient, compassionate and professional. Everyone else we encountered here was respectful and kind as well. Thank you so much to everyone here for creating a seamless and smooth experience during such a hard time. You are appreciated.

google_reviews.author: Sarakvitou Sam
google_reviews.text:
Solie have been great and helpful throughout the entire process during our hard time. A sudden loss of my stepfather had my family and I overwhelmed emotionally, which made it hard to begin to think of what to do next.

My family and I had never had any prior experience with funerals before in the US. Although my family knew the set of Cambodian traditions to perform after the death of a loved one, they still did not know how many Cambodian traditions could be carried out in the US and how many in a funeral home. Regardless, my family wanted at the very least, monk services (reciting scripts/sermons) to be performed for him at the funeral day throughout the event, and right before his cremation took place. So, I called up a few places on the pamphlet that Providence had given me to see if any of the funeral homes on the list could accommodate our requirements. When I made my initial call to Solie, they were very understanding of the situation, and had told me that they had provided services for Cambodian families before. What had stood out to me the most is their ability to provide details about their services and to articulate the description of Cambodian services done by those clients. With the information they gave me from the phone call, my family was able to decide exactly what needed to be done and what expectations to have.

Solie was also quite responsive with their communication (email, and phone call) and was able to work quickly with our requirements. My family wanted to hold the funeral for my stepfather within the first week of his passing, preferably before the 7th day from the day he passed (traditional reason). Only a couple of hours after I made the call to Providence to inform the funeral home choice, I received a call from Solie that my stepfather had been taken into their care. Fast forward to the days of services, every staff was very helpful with any requests we had made.

This might be too small of a detail but I would like to mention this because I think someone might find it useful. It might have escaped my mind to think of the next steps would be after the funeral services were done. But Paul was very attentive and had asked if we had already considered a place to keep my stepfather (whether it is a mausoleum or something else). So, we were quick to choose a cemetery and explore different placement options, which helped us placing my stepfather in time soon after the services were done.

Bottom line is I strongly recommend Solie for any families who seek a helpful, diligent, and wonderful funeral home for their loved one.

google_reviews.author: Irina Bugariu
google_reviews.text: I recently used this funeral home for my dad’s service, and they were outstanding from start to finish. Every detail was handled with care, professionalism, and respect. google_reviews.author: Angie Mata
google_reviews.text: I am more than happy with the service we received from Sumner Voiles. google_reviews.author: Heather Cooper
google_reviews.text: When my father passed away recently, he had not made any burial arrangements. Sumner Voiles was recommended to us. They were professional and compassionate throughout the whole process. We highly recommend them!

google_reviews.author: Anita K
google_reviews.text: Our brother passed away unexpectedly. We were very emotional and not sure what we should do. We chose Sumner Voiles and were glad we did. We appreciate everything they did for us. Thank you all very much.

name: Sunrise Cremation Society Funeral Home
street: 1727 East Marine View Drive Suite B

google_reviews.author: Carmelita K
google_reviews.text: They did not follow through as promised.  Extra fees that are tacked on. Did not appear to care about their services when trying to compare pricing.  They said “ well then go somewhere else” and I did.  I went to Common Sense Cremation and Was amazed at the wonderful follow through.  Two very nice ladies came and picked up my fathers “sleeve” as promised.   They promptly called me that afternoon and set up an appointment for next day.  Sat down with Julie and she was sooooo caring. No pressure sales.  Showed us the options they had and my mother was able to choose a beautiful heart shaped urn that she could hold comfortably in her hand while grieving.  I quizzed Julie on everything about her job and processes.  They even have scanner tracking to make sure they know where the sleeve is at all times. Very impressed.

google_reviews.author: Jamie Smith
google_reviews.text: After the unexpected loss of my step daughters mom we were overwhelmed and unknowledgeable about the arrangement process. Sunrise Cremation was amazing during the entire process, walking us through what to expect step by step. We had a complicated situation since the deceased was an unclaimed person. The staff at Sunrise was patient, kind, knowledgeable, helpful and much more affordable than other crematoriums we looked at. They even assisted us in picking out mourning jewelry.

google_reviews.author: Michael Close
google_reviews.text:
My mom past just this last weekend and the staff were right on top of arrangements. I went in early in the week to select the plan that I could afford with the life insurance policy. They worked with me in covering the costs with insurance which was easy and quick. I would recommend this location if you are needing friendly, fast, compassionate and professional service in your time of loss.

Thank you Sunrise.

Michael Peterson
Everett, WA

google_reviews.author: Tom Stalcup
google_reviews.text:
This man Julius scammed my wife and I out of 1,445.
We thought things were suspicious after meeting with
Him and asked if he could provide a refund. He told my wife it would take 30 days. After 30 days we contacted him again when we did not receive it, he said " I just processed it last week it should be pending". We contacted our bank to dispute the claim and during the dispute he filed paperwork to them stating he had completed services for us, which he did not. This slime ball had the audacity to upload an unsigned document after the fact and is trying to say my wife signed when she did not. Do not wast your time or Money this is a Scam !

google_reviews.author: Delores Andrews
google_reviews.text: Sunrise Cremation Society was there for my family in our darkest hour. Their prices were affordable and the services were very professional. Our loved one was handled with much love. Thank you for your excellent service.

google_reviews.author: Craig Levin
google_reviews.text:

From the very first phone call, they were professional, compassionate, and incredibly responsive. When we notified them of my dad’s passing, their team arrived at our home within two hours, which brought immediate comfort during a very emotional moment.

Throughout the process, Jamie Vanasse (Funeral Director) and Pat Caffall (Family Service Advisor) were thoughtful, organized, and thorough. They guided us through each step with patience and care, making sure everything was handled smoothly and respectfully.

We’re very grateful to Jamie, Pat, and the entire team for their kindness and professionalism. They made a very difficult time much easier for our family.

google_reviews.author: Frank Dean
google_reviews.text: My father and I recently made funeral arrangements for my mother who was cremated. Jamie guided us through the entire process and made a difficult time in our lives less stressful. Jamie was kind, compassionate, and supportive and we are grateful for everything she did for our family. Sunset Hills new funeral home is beautiful, welcoming, and up lifting.

google_reviews.author: Ron Almanza
google_reviews.text: My father passed away not long ago & Mel Higgins & her team at Sunset Hills Memorial Park & Cemetery were amazing. They all went beyond what I would not expect from a funeral home.  From the moment we stepped in their property & her office to have them explain the nuisances of what we needed to do & what we will expect from her staff during the process, we were treated very well. We were treated with respect, compassion & love. I would highly recommend Sunset Hills to anyone with Mel Higgins, Pat Caffall & at your service.

google_reviews.author: Ramona Abbasian
google_reviews.text:
Having just lost my mom and feeling incredibly vulnerable, I was deeply grateful to have met Jamie at Sunset Hills. Her "can-do" attitude, along with the compassion and respect she showed in honoring my mom throughout the entire process, meant more than words can express.
Every question I had—no matter how small—was answered promptly and thoughtfully after our initial meeting. Jamie’s support was steady and genuine.
I’m also especially thankful to Pat, who ensured every detail of the graveside service was handled with care and precision. Nothing was overlooked—every “t” crossed, every “i” dotted. The service itself was smooth, meaningful, and beautifully carried out.
Throughout both the planning and the day of my mom’s service, I felt as though Jamie and Pat were symbolically holding my hand. Their kindness and professionalism brought so much comfort during an incredibly difficult time.
I will be forever grateful to Jamie, Pat, and the entire team at Sunset Hills for helping us give my mom the farewell she deserved.

google_reviews.author: Lori Lau
google_reviews.text: Steve Walker at Sunset Hills helped me with planning our funeral and cemetery arrangements.  There was a lot of info and it was overwhelming but he was patient, kind and professional.  I asked a lot of questions sometimes repeatedly, but he remained very patient and showed true sincerity and care for what was best for my family. I would highly recommend seeing Steve Walker at Sunset Hills in Bellevue.

google_reviews.author: Bronx
google_reviews.text: A few days ago, we viewed our very beloved Bronx and kissed him farewell as he went over the rainbow bridge & into the Spirit world. Later that day, we picked him up and brought his urn to rest at peacefully at home with us. The pet manager Evelyn and staff at Tacoma Mausoleum & Mortuary were very informative, kind and made the entire process stress free. We can't thank them enough for what they did for us and do for the general public.  I would recommend them to anyone who is seeking or is unsure of what to do for their beloved animal for end of life services.  Being able to view the process in it's entirety and pick Bronx up the same day in a beautiful urn is just what I wanted. Thank you Tacoma Mausoleum & Mortuary!  We love you Bronx!!

google_reviews.author: Larissa Betty
google_reviews.text: Our Belgian Malinois passed recently and we utilized their services for cremation. They took nose and paw prints for us. I would have liked the fur clipping but we had mentioned originally that we had taken some fur so I believe there may have been confusion on if we wanted more. However, we received his ashes within about two weeks. I like the box it was placed into and the engraving. It's nice to have our boy back home.

google_reviews.author: Sonya Breithaupt
google_reviews.text: We took our beloved pomeranian here to be cremated after her death. I am very happy with the care they provided. They collected noise prints and paw prints, and were timely, professional, and compassionate. They also offer additional services including clay paws and various urn options. Thank you very much for your care and attention to detail. We are very grateful.

google_reviews.author: Fred
google_reviews.text:
I honestly wish I had never set foot in Tacoma Mausoleum. Dealing with them made an already horrible situation even worse.

The building was filthy, smelled awful. The office was cluttered and they had paperwork scattered everywhere. I saw people's personal contact information just sitting out in the open.

Nothing was clear. Getting straight answers felt like pulling teeth, and everyone gave off this cold, dismissive vibe like nobody wanted to be there

What really did it for me was overhearing the funeral director Colin talking with staff. I heard him making fun of other customers behind their backs about how they had no money. Grieving people. That alone was disgusting and showed exactly what kind of operation this is when they think no one’s listening. He seemed like a nice guy but I guess that was just a act

And then, somehow, it got worse. I also overheard 2 of the employees talking about some PILE OF HUMAN REMAINS??? under the building, talked about casually, like it was normal or no big deal. I honestly couldn't believe it, I wrote a email to the health department but no response

Once you hear things like that, you can’t un-hear them

If you’re considering this place, DON'T. I wish I'd never been here
This place added stress and shock to a time that was already unbearable. They asked me to leave a Google review so that's what I'm doing. I would never recommend this god awful place to anyone for any amount of money

google_reviews.author: Laura Murphy
google_reviews.text: This place is disgustingly filthy.  The buildings are filthy.  They must have a rule against pressure washers and paint.  The tiny office is filthy, smelly and packed with debris.  It hasn't seen paint in years. I picked up my pets ashes today and the box was nice. That's all the positive I have. I hope I don't have nightmares tonight. What a creepshow. Seriously the most foul place I've been in years.

name: The Co-op Funeral Home of People's Memorial

My Dad died April 2025 and just got a bill over $1600 to pay for cremation. They paid 15 percent. That’s way over priced and misleading. Currently living in Arizona and looking at Cremation plans at $800. Beware of Peoples memorial very misleading

We hold your business with great respect and we would recommend The Co-op Funeral Home of People’s Memorial and Return Home to anyone in need of funeral services.  Thank you for your exceptional professional service to the community.
On behalf of the Hatch and Jiles families, we thank you so much!

google_reviews.author: Rick Johnson

google_reviews.author: Jessica McNamara
google_reviews.text:
The people here at co-op were extremely helpful in helping me with an uncommon request that had to go through a funeral home. I had a bilateral orchiectomy and wanted to keep my testicles for religious reasons. Many awkward phone calls were had with a number of other funeral homes as I learned how to explain what I was hoping to accomplish. When I contacted the co-op funeral home they knew what I was looking for, had assisted people before with this kind of request, and were supportive and helpful throughout the entire process. google_reviews.author: Anna Nagy
google_reviews.text: My nephew’s service was held in the chapel, and a small reception in the common room- the staff was wonderful and so accommodating. The grounds are stunning and so peaceful. The suggested officiant was also tremendous. They really did a marvelous job from start to finish.

google_reviews.author: Stephanie Goroza
google_reviews.text:
Sarah and Nicky took very good care of my father until I could arrive in Washington. We were able to get everything started over the phone. My father had passed alone in his apartment. The funeral home had the foresight to look around and find his important papers and wallet which made my life much easier with the death certificate and all the other million things needed to do when a loved one passes. They are very honest, as well. They found money on him which they applied to the cremation services.

The price was very good. They bundle a cremation package which includes the death certificate, his transportation, their services etc. Also, they worked hard to get my dad's death certificate for me before I left Washington, which I did not expect. I was only in town 3 1/2 days to clean out his apartment and had it in hand before boarding my plane.

Most importantly, they comforted me during this difficult time. They always took my calls and I sometimes spoke to them 3-4 times a day. They also kept me informed via email before I arrived. They treated my father with respect and dignity and me with kindness Thank you so much Sarah and Nicky. I really don't know how I would have gotten through that week if it was anyone else.

google_reviews.author: Dan Wade
google_reviews.text:
I lost my wife and brother to cancer about 45 days apart. Tuell McKee treated my loved ones with respect, and dignity. I was treated with compassion, and warmth.

Not once was my grief an upsell or my loss some kind of way to make money. I was charged a very fair price for my loved ones to be cremated. TMFH kept me in the loop the entire time, and made sure that I didn't have to to hound them.

To those claiming "they tried to rip me off", I highly doubt it. I have referred a number of people over the years.

google_reviews.author: Hannah Heilman
google_reviews.text: Sarah was extremely compassionate and helpful.  This was my first experience with having to make arrangements with a funeral home, and it could not have been more seamless.  Sarah's professionalism and kindness carried me through the entire process.  I would recommend Tuell-McKee to my friends and family.

google_reviews.author: Kelsey Colmore
google_reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Sarah for my moms cremation. She was so so kind to us and very patient with all our questions and everything just felt very genuine and thoughtful. I 100% recommend this funeral home, and well done to Sarah for making this experience so easy and fast. Not a bad word to say. Thank you Tuell-McKee

google_reviews.author: Elizabeth Stone
google_reviews.text: As I posted on the Bremerton location, I have entrusted my loved ones with Tuell-McKee THREE times so far and each encounter was compassionate and professional. They must be doing something right to have been in the community since 1926 and have 3 locations. their charges are a fraction of other providers in the area. And IF you can find another company that is a little less, I would tell you that you get what you pay for. Their staff does NOT treat you as they are trying to sell you a car and they don't come off as the dollar is the main focus of the conversation (I called another provider in UP area and felt like he didn't care about anything but "giving me a good deal and beat anyone's prices". If you want people who are in this business to help YOU and care about YOU, then I would highly recommend Tuell-McKee.

google_reviews.author: K M
google_reviews.text: In the time when the worst possible thing in your life happens, the entire staff at Tuell-McKee was professional, helpful, and respectful.  Great communication as well.  I don't know how they are as affordable as they are, but we saw no signs of cutting corners on anything.  Thank you for taking care of our needs.

google_reviews.author: Jessica Koyama
google_reviews.text: Very professional and compassionate. Excellent with communication. Made everything easy during the process. Ethan and the rest of the team have been nothing but amazing!

Thank you again Tuell-McKee for helping me and my family we appreciate your compassion and caring demeanor.

I could take the time to walk around to every family member and share fond memories. We got to let go.. and let the staff take care of what WE needed. I highly recommend First Call Plus to anyone who has lost a dear friend or family member. They truly CARE. They take pride in their work and never waver even as families are sobbing in their faces. My grandma was in good hands, and I know she would have approved.... AND SHE WAS A PARTICULAR LADY!!! From the beginning to the ending truly believe even my grandma got to keep her pride. Thank you first call. Cynthia, Shayla, Brian, Leslie thank you for letting me see her beautiful face again and taking care of her and my family in any way possible!

NOT  HAPPY with this place, CANNOT recommend their service’s as far as reliability if delivery.

Craig was incompetent in the extreme. Also, he had dreadful phone etiquette (long silences - I kept having to ask "are you still there?") Thankfully, Autumn called the next day and fixed all the mistakes in just a few minutes. She was terrific, but nothing could have made up for the experience with Craig.

google_reviews.author: Daniel Romero
google_reviews.text: My wife passed away from cancer at 37. I say this to let you know we are not the traditional sort when it comes to a funerary experience and Westford was extremely friendly and accommodating to all the quirky Millennial shenanigans that we required for my wife's viewing. Maureen and Ally were extremely amazing in particular and make the whole horrifying experience as easy as it could be. I hope I never have need of their services again, but if I do, I know where in Bellingham I'll go.

google_reviews.author: Britt Hanowell
google_reviews.text:
Westford Funeral Home took care of my family with so much kindness and compassion. Ally, the funeral director we worked with, struck the perfect balance—professional yet personal—guiding us through everything without adding stress or pressure while remaining transparent about the process and cost.

Ally and her team went above and beyond, helping us navigate every detail and coordinating with Hospice House, the funeral home, the Catholic Church, and Bayview. Every step of the way, they provided advice, gentle reminders, clear direction, extra resources and guides, and the space to be involved in caring for my aunt—including dressing her ourselves, which meant so much.

After the burial, we held a small potluck reception in their reception space. This is a beautiful and welcome place. We brought the food, and they made sure we had everything we needed—from tablecloths and dinnerware to plenty of coffee, a sound system for my aunt’s favorite songs, and a slideshow of our favorite photos to help us celebrate her life.

Ally’s expertise, skill, and genuine care made a huge difference, and her intern, April, was both knowledgeable and a joy to work with.

Out of the three funeral homes I’ve worked with for family, this was by far the best experience. Westford turned what can be a painfully chaotic time into a well-organized, comforting experience that truly brought our family together. I highly recommend them.

google_reviews.author: Søren Ireland
google_reviews.text: I cannot recommend Westford Funeral Home in Bellingham, WA, highly enough. Rob Westford and his team provided exceptional service during an incredibly difficult time for our family. From the very beginning, Rob was compassionate, attentive, and professional, ensuring that every detail was handled with care. His outstanding customer service made a potentially overwhelming process much easier to navigate. The attention to detail throughout the entire process, from the arrangements to the memorial service, was impeccable. We truly felt that our loved one was treated with the utmost respect. The value of their services is also remarkable—highly affordable for the level of care and professionalism they provide. Thank you, Rob, and the entire team at Westford Funeral Home, for your dedication and support. You made a lasting impact on our family, and we are deeply grateful.

google_reviews.author: John Smith
google_reviews.text: Extremely professional staff and knowledgeable to answer any question and many we couldn’t even think of to ask. Exhibited tenderness and compassion for what we were going through.

google_reviews.author: Brittany Fuentes
google_reviews.text: This business has been so compassionate to our family as we navigate challenging times of loss on multiple occasion.There is a no pressure sales environment, they express their condolences and give many options. We want to send our heartfelt thanks for your honesty and quality service without undue financial burden.

google_reviews.author: Kennedy Smith
google_reviews.text: We used your services in 2015 and it was so simple and easy. My family just used a funeral home in a different area, and after that headache I wanted to tell you how much I appreciate you all over again. Especially the low cost and no pressure to upgrade.

google_reviews.author: naftx
google_reviews.text: We received information on cremation and funerals from the hospice my dad was in. Whatcom Cremation and Funeral had clear pricing and information available. Everything was handled professionally, efficiently and smoothly. When we got the final bill it was what we expected with no surprises. The owner was available in the office, by phone, and by email and went out of his way to follow up on death certificates that seemed to take a long time arriving from the county. I would recommend Whatcom Cremation and Funeral.

google_reviews.author: Pandora Drossos
google_reviews.text: I can't say enough good about this place and it's people. They took care of us through my mom's passing, a few months ago.  They were so professional and knowledgeable, seriously kind and compassionate. Truly special people doing an amazing job helping people in this delicate space. Highly highly recommend.

google_reviews.author: Louis
google_reviews.text:
I toured a few units with Jayren, and he genuinely made the whole experience stand out amongst all the other apartment complexes available in Ballard. He was extremely attentive, easy to talk to, and clearly very good at what he does. Everything was organized, his explanations were clear, and he had all the details ready without me even needing to ask. google_reviews.author: Cristobal Droste
google_reviews.text: Best building I’ve lived in so far! The staff is always friendly and responsive, and the management team really cares about residents. They recently improved the club room and got rid of the dog park smell, which made a huge difference. The maintenance team is quick to solve any issue, and the common areas are always clean and well-kept. Highly recommend!

google_reviews.author: Hayden Cody-Jensen
google_reviews.text:
TLDR: Do not live here, you and your property are not safe. If I could give negative stars, I would. This is an Avenue5 managed property, a cursory Google search will tell you everything you need to know about who they are and why they have no business managing properties. The management team of The Wilcox is not only incompetent at running a large apartment complex but incapable of providing basic security for tenants and their property.

The property itself is overall satisfactory, the units feel modern and comfortable with functional appliances. But all of that is grossly overshadowed by the management team’s inane policies and steadfast commitment to their own self-interests over basic tenant needs. While I could write a tell-all book about my negative experience, I will summarize the key points below in the hope that it deters you from patronizing this or any other Avenue5 property.

Forced Fees: The first fee you are forced to pay is for the Trash Valet service, a waste removal service where you leave your recycling in a bin outside your door for collection. While this is a convenient service as any recycling waste must be taken down to the parking garage by hand, you as a tenant have no option for whether you want to opt in. I lived on the second floor and was more than capable of taking out my own recycling and did not want to pay the $25/month fee for the Trash Valet service. When I told management this, they said it is policy at all Avenue5 properties and while I don’t have to use the service, I am still required to pay the fee. The next fee is for using the complex’s club room. Most apartment complexes ask for a deposit to use such rooms that is then returned contingent on any damages. The Wilcox asks for a $250 fee to just use the room that is non-refundable, even if no damages occur. Not to mention that they do not allow alcohol to be consumed in the room, treating the space as if it were a Freshman dorm. Lastly, there is a $15/month fee to use the bike storage area. This fee is predicated on providing tenants a “secure” area to store your bikes, yet it is anything but secure. This is further explained in my next item.

Failed Security: While The Wilcox cannot be held responsible for all security failures, the way in which they handle break-ins is incredibly concerning. As mentioned above, there is a $15/month fee to use the bike storage area, a space on the second floor of the garage that sits behind a locked door, requiring a fob to access. In October 2025, someone broke into the garage and gained access to the locked bike storage. They cut multiple locks and stole bikes, including my $4000 mountain bike. The only action taken by The Wilcox was to send an email the next day saying “we had some unwanted garage activity last night” and then goes on to detail how tenants are responsible for the security of the building. There was no mention of a break-in, no mention of property being stolen, and no suggestions around checking personal property for damages/losses. Someone broke into their “secure” garage and bike storage, and rather than taking an ounce of accountability and working with tenants, they failed to disclose what actually happened and deflected responsibility to the tenants. Screenshot of the email is attached.

Management Revolving Door: Since Avenue5 took over, I have seen 3 different property managers come and go. Each manager lasted only a few months and while not a significant issue, it does pose challenges for tenants looking for any kind of consistency. The other consideration here is why is there is such a revolving door. I believe this a reflection of how poorly Avenue5 treats its employees, aligning perfectly with how they treat their tenants.

In conclusion, The Wilcox as an apartment complex is perfectly fine, but it is the Avenue5 property management that makes it an unpleasant living experience at best. If you value security of yourself and your belongings do not live here - The Wilcox does not treat their tenants as people but rather another rent check.

google_reviews.author: Cameron Ellis
google_reviews.text:
I was here for 2 years (Aug 2019 - Sept 2021) and these are my thoughts on living here:

- The photos that I've attached are of the S2 unit that I lived in
- Overall, I would recommend living here if you can find a good deal. Otherwise, I'd consider other options

Pros:
+ The walls are fairly thick. I never once heard anything from my neighbors on either side of me
+ Plenty of cabinet and closet space (at least for a single person)
+ Relatively fast elevators
+ Built in internet modems (via CenturyLink / Lumen) to quickly get internet for 100 mbps at $40 / month the day you move in
+ Dedicated Amazon delivery lockers
+ Property management team is receptive to security concerns. They've added more locks to doors so it's not as easy to get to resident property
+ Property management team is good and friendly with communication (via email) regarding issues that impact the entire complex (e.g. broken elevator, broken door to parking garage, no hot water, excessive heat warnings). Thankfully utility issues like this are uncommon.

Cons:
- Some units do not have windows that let in a lot of air, making circulation a concern (specifically floor plan S2)
- No A/C. Strongly recommend buying a portable unit for yourself for the summer months. A good floor fan is a minimum. Especially if your windows are west facing
- Inadvisable to go out at night in this neighborhood, especially near the Ballard commons park
- The trash and recycling service is mandatory and is $18/month
- The floors are relatively thin in the building. It can be easy to hear your neighbors above you walking around if they're not mindful of it. Property management isn't much help here. It's better to talk to your neighbors about it directly and exchange phone numbers. I recommend renting on the top floor if you can afford to.
- There's construction that's planned to take place adjacent to and across the street from the apartment complex
- The main reason I moved was for work. I would have stayed otherwise

google_reviews.author: Kaylie Diteman
google_reviews.text:
Absolutely love living at The Wilcox!

From the moment I moved in, the experience has been nothing short of amazing. The building is modern, clean, and located in the heart of Ballard—close to everything you need, yet tucked away enough to feel peaceful and private.

A huge shoutout to Blaine and Jacob—they’ve been incredibly helpful, friendly, and responsive. Whether it’s answering questions, helping with move-in logistics, or just being a welcoming presence in the building, they go above and beyond to make residents feel at home.

Also, major kudos to the maintenance team—they’re prompt, professional, and always keep the building in top shape. Any issue I’ve had has been resolved quickly and with care.

If you’re looking for a place in Ballard that combines comfort, convenience, and a truly supportive team, The Wilcox is it. Highly recommend!

google_reviews.author: Rob Scott
google_reviews.text: Having recently lost a love one,  Mr. Hunter Hallford representing the Woodlawn Funeral home and Cemetery assisted us through the process. Several twists and turns throughout the process presented difficult and frustrating situations. Hunter was always very reassuring and supportive. He was informative offering assistance at every step. What impressed me most was that on a couple of occasions Mr. Hallford assisted by retrieving  information from a couple rude and disrespectful people. He handled both situations with stellar expertise, de-escalating their aggression and extracting the needed information. Hunter treated my loved one and I like Family.  This young man has a strong future in his chosen profession.

google_reviews.author: Matthew Lile
google_reviews.text: Staff was extremely helpful, caring, and patient during the planning and execution of my mom’s Memorial Ceremony. Especially Hayley and Alec. Facilities and additional accommodations were completely functional and resulted in a beautiful send off and tribute to my Mother. I had her cremated and her remains shipped in from out of state, so I can’t speak to their burial or grounds services, but this business did a wonderful job and service on behalf of me and my family. Also, we were sure what to do with all of the flower arrangements following the ceremony, so Hayley made a recommendation to donate them to a nearby nursing home, and we did. The flower donation made the staff and residents light up with appreciation and glee. I think that would have also pleased my mother despite never having to reside in a nursing home. Thank you Woodlawn for helping us to give my beloved mom a proper send off.

google_reviews.author: Timothy Gould
google_reviews.text: Woodlawn Funeral Home personnel are wonderful, caring, and very understanding. From the very beginning, they take the time to get to know the deceased and the family. They also walk you through the beginning of the journey until the very end. Their pricing is the best I have seen throughout many Funeral Homes. Again, very caring, loving and understanding and really do make all aspects personable and confidential. Thank you very much for all your dedication and professionalism throughout my journey. It has been a life changing experience working along side everyone at Woodlawn Funeral Home! 🙏🙏😇😇🙏🙏

google_reviews.author: Daniel Slocum
google_reviews.text: Woodlawn treated us with great dignity and respect. Sadly, death is something we all must face. Woodlawn made our experience easier. I

google_reviews.author: T M
google_reviews.text: I wanted to say thank you to Miss Hayley. This woman has been so helpful to me and my family. She took the time to listen and understand my situation 😢 Hayley thank you for everything you have done for me. Thank you for your support and compassionate towards me and my family. The service was well organized. I appreciate you very much. Keep up the great work ❤️

google_reviews.author: Steve Lee
google_reviews.text:
This is an exemplary funeral home. The staff are exceptional, compassionate, and very accommodating during such a difficult time. I especially appreciated being able to share our family’s stories and our journey to America with Rhonda, who is a truly kind and attentive listener.

The owner also goes above and beyond—he even assists with driving when needed—and is an outstanding individual. I hold this establishment in the highest regard.

Our pastor, who officiated the service, was remarkable. He offered thoughtful and comforting words about the passing of our loved ones, including my sister and father. Seeing them in the casket was deeply emotional, but it also brought a sense of peace, knowing their spirits have been lifted and they are no longer suffering. While we continue to grieve, we take comfort in knowing they are at rest.

I strongly recommend Yahn & Son to anyone in need of funeral services. They also offer caskets for purchase, if desired.

google_reviews.author: Katie Dame
google_reviews.text: The employees handled my dad with care and dignity. They were kind, courteous, and respectful. They had a special American flag wrap for him at the time of removal because he was a veteran. They explained everything well to my mom and I and weren't at all pushy. Exemplary job. I will definitely trust them with my family members' final care in the future and have already recommended their services. Robin was our funeral director, and she and Kate went above and beyond for us at a very difficult time.

google_reviews.author: lashanna w
google_reviews.text:
Updated:
The transportation crew was a third party contractor and has since apologized and made adjustments to the way that they honour the wishes of the people we are caring for.  There is a way to honor decedents and a way to follow health conscious and safe protocol. I appreciate James for thinking about the ways that changes could be made and reaching back out to have a conversation about it. Because of that I am adjusting and updating this review.

Original Review:
Two transportation folks came to our door without calling with an ETA, walked in, didn’t say hello or introduce themselves. Not even a sorry for your loss. When I asked them if they had shoe covers, the woman acted like asked her to do something so out of line. I offered her and her husband  disposable shoe covers and they scoffed. I let them know our decedent was shrouded, in a legal manner for WA law and we didn’t need the plastic bag or the quilt.

He said, I’ll come in a see the situation. When I agreed and said once more, the decedent was legally covered, he said enough with you people and said we’re sending another team.

The woman then scoffed again and accused us of telling her husband how to do his job. I said no mam, I’m just telling you what’s legal. This person can leave here in his shroud, once he’s in your care, you do as your company mandates.
0/10 I would never trust these two to care for a family  experiencing a loss.  So disappointing.

google_reviews.author: SuddenChaos
google_reviews.text: I am a licensed funeral director in the state of WA. When my grandmother passed away in another state THIS is the funeral home i choose to assist. We had my grandmother sent to us from California to be buried with my grandfather at the National Cemetery. Take it from someone that knows... they are the best, they have the CLEANEST sheltering areas (something the public doesnt see) and they will treat you and your family with kindness and respect.

google_reviews.author: Mary Gleason
google_reviews.text: When we initially called to start arrangement I spoke with Rhonda. She was so kind, patient, and caring. When we came in to make arrangements she was very patient as we worked through our grief. She took the times to say the right things to ease us through planning something so devastating to our hearts and souls. The day we came in for viewing Rob was kind and considerate. He was very patient with is all as we said good bye to our son.
